example: The comet's luminous coma glowed brilliantly as intense solar heat vaporized frozen volatile compounds in the core. (當強烈的太陽熱量蒸發核心內冰凍的揮發性化合物時，彗星發光的彗髮鮮豔地（輝煌地）閃耀。)
The researcher filled the beaker to the brim with the chemical solution before starting the titration process. (在開始滴定程序之前，研究人員將化學溶液加滿至燒杯的邊緣。)
Isolated landlocked seas experiencing high solar evaporation deposit thick salt layers as brine crystallizes. (經歷強烈太陽蒸發的隔離內陸海，隨著濃鹽水結晶而沉積出厚厚的鹽層。)
Deciduous broadleaf forests dominate temperate zones experiencing moderate precipitation and four distinct seasons. (落葉闊葉林在經歷適度降雨與四季分明的溫帶地區佔據主導地位。)

meaning: 大張印刷品（早期傳單）；側舷齊射
example: Before printing presses were automated, the single-sheet broadside was the primary medium for news dissemination. (在印刷機自動化之前，單張的大張印刷品是新聞傳播的主要媒介。)
The commercialization of Broadway theater reflected the expanding urban leisure industry of early twentieth-century America. (百老匯劇院的商業化，反映了二十世紀初美國擴張中的城市休閒產業。)

meaning: 山丘；山嶺（常用於威爾斯地名）
example: The small cottage was perched high on the grassy bryn, offering a panoramic view of the Welsh countryside. (這間小木屋坐落在綠草如茵的山丘高處，可將威爾斯鄉村的風光盡收眼底。)
Extrusive basalt lava cools rapidly under seabed ocean water, freezing into a porous, bubbly structural texture. (噴出的玄武岩岩漿在海床海洋水下快速冷卻，凝固成一種多孔、充滿氣泡的結構紋理。)
Indigenous gatherer tribes processed wild deer hides utilizing stone scrapers to fashion durable buckskin clothing. (原住民採集部落利用石製刮削器處理野生鹿皮，以製作出耐用的鹿皮服裝。)
The continuous buildup of ice sheets during periods of glaciation triggered a substantial global drop in sea levels. (在冰河作用期間冰原的持續累積，引發了全球海平面的大幅下降。)
The construction company deployed a massive mechanical bulldozer to clear fieldstones and layout the new urban transit line. (建築公司部署了一台大型的機械推土機來清理野石，並規劃新的城市交通線路。)

meaning: 大頭香蒲；香蒲（常生於濕地）
example: Migratory coastal brant geese often forage within marshy river lowland channels rich in dense bullrush vegetation. (遷徙的沿海黑雁，經常在富含密集香蒲植被的沼澤河流低地通道內進行覓食。)
The porous, gaseous structure of pumice rock renders it uniquely buoyant, allowing it to float on seawater surfaces. (浮石多孔、含氣體的結構使其具備獨特的浮力，容許它漂浮在海水表面上。)
The bur of certain plants is covered in hooked prickles that cling to passing animals, aiding in seed dispersal. (某些植物的刺果表面佈滿鉤刺，能附著在路過的動物身上，有助於種子傳播。)
Sedentary agrarian communities began to burgeon globally once early agriculturalists successfully mastered grain domestication metrics. (一旦早期的農業勞動者成功掌握了穀物馴化指標，定居的農業社群便開始在全球範圍內蓬勃發展（激增）。)

meaning: （舊時的）市民；公民；中產階級居民
example: In early mercantile metropolitan jurisdictions, a wealthy burgher elite controlled trade monopolies and taxed local craftspeople. (在早期的商業大都市司法管轄區中，富有的市民（中產階級居民）精英控制著貿易壟斷並向地方手工藝人徵稅。)

meaning: 叢林居民（尤指非洲布希曼人）
example: The cultural anthropologist studied how the African bushman hunter groups traced animal footprints across arid sands. (文化人類學家研究了非洲叢林居民（布希曼人）狩獵群體如何跨越乾旱沙地追蹤動物足跡。)
The European mercantile duke employed a wealthy butler elite class to manage the grand palace edifice. (這位歐洲商業公爵雇用了一群富有的男管家班底，來管理宏偉的宮殿建築。)

meaning: 細木工匠；高級家具製造商
example: An expert cabinetmaker handcrafted the detailed cedar woodworks inside Pullman sleeping cars utilizing stable mortise joints. (高級家具細木工匠利用穩固的榫接，手工製作出普爾曼臥鋪車廂內部精細的雪松木工製品。)
The polar explorers established a secure cache of provisions to supply their return journey across the ice shelf. (極地探險隊建立了安全的物資儲藏處，以供應他們橫跨冰架的返程。)
The crop failure had calamitous economic consequences for the farming community. (作物歉收給農業社區帶來了災難性的經濟後果。)
The accumulation of fossilized shells from marine foraminifera forms thick layers of calcareous ooze across the seabed. (海洋有孔蟲化石外殼的累積，在海床上形成了厚厚的鈣質軟泥層。)
Calcite is the principal constituent mineral in limestone and dissolves readily when exposed to acidic water. (方解石是石灰岩中的主要成分礦物，暴露於酸性水中時極易溶解。)
The financial risks of the investment are calculable with current tools. (利用目前的工具，該投資的財務風險是可以計算的。)

meaning: 卡羅法攝影（早期紙基攝影術）
example: The calotype process generated paper negatives, allowing early documentarians to reproduce multiple copies of urban prints. (卡羅法攝影產生了紙質負片，容許早期的紀錄片工作者複製多份城市印刷畫。)
As global temperatures escalate, massive polar glaciers begin to calve immense icebergs directly into ocean channels. (隨著全球氣溫攀升，巨大的極地冰河開始崩解出巨大的冰山，直接落入海洋通道。)
The predatory insect developed geometric camouflage that perfectly mimics the pattern of decaying deciduous leaves. (這隻捕食性昆蟲發展出了完美的幾何偽裝，完美模仿腐爛落葉的圖案。)
Before kerosene lamps modernized indoor illumination, urban tenement quarters depended entirely on dim candlelight fields. (在煤油燈使室內照明現代化之前，城市廉租公寓宿舍完全依賴微弱的燭光照明。)
Archaeologists found iron cannonball remains embedded inside the fort walls, indicating an intense historical siege. (考古學家在堡壘牆壁內發現了嵌入的鐵製大砲彈殘留，顯示曾發生過一場激烈的歷史圍攻戰。)
Indigenous tribes manufactured dugout canoes from hollowed tree trunks to navigate river trade routes. (原住民部落用挖空樹幹製造出獨木舟，以在河流貿易路線中航行。)
Volunteers went door-to-door to canvass voters before the local election. (志工在地方選舉前挨家挨戶向選民遊說。)
Indigenous river dwellers harvested wetland reed stalks to weave light, cany storage receptacles for agricultural surpluses. (原住民河流居民採集濕地蘆葦稈，以編織出輕巧、似藤條（蘆葦狀）的儲藏容器來儲存農業剩餘。)
Capillary action forces groundwater upward through tiny spaces in clay soils against gravitational pull. (毛細管作用迫使地下水穿過黏土層中的微小空間，對抗重力向上流動。)
A violent ocean eddy can easily capsize small fishing canoes navigating near rugged coastal fault lines. (湍急的海洋渦流很容易使在崎嶇沿海斷層線附近航行的小型捕魚獨木舟翻覆。)
A mercantile caravan navigated across the hyper-arid Sahara, transporting salt blocks and processed textiles. (一支商業商隊航行橫跨極度乾旱的撒哈拉，運輸鹽塊和加工織品。)
Marine organisms extract calcium and carbonate ions from seawater to construct protective shells. (海洋生物從海水中提取鈣離子和碳酸根離子，以構建保護性的外殼。)
Chemical weathering accelerates when carbonic acid inside falling rainwater dissolves limestone rock structures. (當落下雨水內部的碳酸溶解石灰岩岩石結構時，化學風化作用會加速。)
The Carboniferous period featured extensive, swampy wetland forests whose compressed scale layers solidified into modern coal bedrocks. (石炭紀以廣闊、沼澤的濕地森林為特色，其被壓縮的植物層凝固成了現代的煤炭基岩。)
The opportunistic scavenger mammal relied chiefly on feeding from the organic carcass remains left by apex theropod predators. (機會主義的食腐哺乳動物，主要依賴以頂級獸腳類捕食者留下的有機動物屍體殘骸為食。)
Endothermic polar marine mammals possess specialized cardiac vascular adaptations to regulate internal core metabolic heat levels. (內溫性的極地海洋哺乳動物具備特化的心臟血管適應能力，以調節內部核心的新陳代謝熱量水平。)
The nineteenth-century carman navigated heavily laden horse carts across unpaved turnpike routes to transport textiles. (十九世紀的車夫駕駛著載滿貨物的馬車跨越未鋪砌的收費公路路線，以運輸紡織品。)
The Venus flytrap is a famous carnivorous plant that traps and digests small insects to obtain nutrients. (捕蠅草是一種著名的食肉植物，它捕獲並消化昆蟲以獲取營養。)
The knee joint contains a thick layer of cartilage that cushions the bones and absorbs mechanical shock. (膝關節包含一層厚厚的軟骨，能為骨骼提供緩衝並吸收機械衝擊。)
The artisan carver utilized obsidian blades to etch delicate mythological narratives into jade amulets. (這位工匠雕刻師利用黑曜石刀片，將精緻的神話敘事刻入玉石護身符中。)
The artisan perfected the art of bone carving, engraving complex geometric motifs onto tool handles. (這位工匠完美掌握了骨頭雕刻的工藝，將複雜的幾何圖案刻到工具手柄上。)
An ecological cascade happens when removing a top predator triggers unpredictable population swings downstream. (當移除頂級捕食者引發下游不可預測的人口擺動時，就會發生生態連鎖反應。)

meaning: 藥鼠李（其皮可用作瀉藥）
example: Historically, indigenous populations used the bark of the cascara tree as a potent natural remedy for digestive ailments. (在歷史上，原住民群體將藥鼠李樹的樹皮作為治療消化道疾病的強效天然藥物。)
The rapid mechanization of midwest threshing operations served as a critical economic catalyst for sweeping urban migration tracks. (中西部打穀作業的快速機械化，充當了全面城市化遷移軌跡的關鍵經濟催化劑。)
The Cretaceous period concluded with a catastrophic asteroid impact that triggered a global volcanic winter. (白堊紀以一場毀滅性的小行星撞擊結束，該撞擊引發了全球性的火山冬季。)
Greek theatrical tragedies were designed to induce an emotional catharsis within the gathered public audience. (希臘戲劇悲劇旨在聚集的公眾觀眾中，引發一種情感上的宣洩。)
Demographic historians traced late nineteenth-century immigrant concentration maps, tracking Caucasian labor distribution in midwest factories. (人口歷史學家追蹤了十九世紀晚期的移民集中地圖，追蹤中西部工廠內白種人（高加索）勞工的分佈情況。)
Ecologists attempt to map out the explicit causal links between fertilizer runoff and aquatic alga blooms. (生態學家試圖繪製出肥料逕流與水生藻類大量增殖之間明確的因果關係連結。)
The Cavendish banana variant became ecologically vulnerable due to a total lack of genetic variability. (華蕉品種由於完全缺乏基因變異性，在生態上變得非常脆弱。)
The natural aromatic resins inside cedar wood repel wood-boring insects, making it a durable building material. (雪松木內天然的芳香樹脂能驅除鑽木昆蟲，使其成為一種耐用的建築材料。)
Polynesian watercraft masters memorized complex celestial maps to navigate across thousands of miles of open sea. (玻里尼西亞船隻大師記憶複雜的天體地圖，以在數千英里的開闊海域中航行。)
Plant cell walls are composed chiefly of rigid cellulose molecules, which require symbiotic intestinal bacteria to decompose completely. (植物細胞壁主要由僵硬的纖維素分子組成，這需要共生的腸道細菌才能完全分解。)

meaning: 天然井（尤指猶加敦半島的石灰岩溶洞井）
example: The ancient Maya utilized subterranean cenotes as primary freshwater reservoirs and locations for ritual ceremonies. (古代馬雅人利用地底的天然井，作為核心的淡水蓄水池與儀式典禮的地點。)
The Cenozoic era is labeled the 'Age of Mammals' due to the rapid diversification of mammalian life. (新生代因哺乳動物的快速多樣化而被標記為「哺乳動物時代」。)
Dictatorial regimes typically attempt to censor independent news outlets to tightly control public opinion. (獨裁政權通常企圖審查獨立新聞媒體，以嚴密控制公眾輿論。)
The university celebrated its centennial anniversary with a grand ceremony. (這所大學舉行了盛大的儀式慶祝其建校一百週年。)
The study highlights the centrality of early childhood literacy in predicting long-term academic attainment. (該研究強調了幼兒識字能力在預測長期學術成就方面之核心地位。)
The administrative reorganization led to the centralization of financial decision-making within the executive headquarters. (行政重組導致財政決策權集中於執行總部。)
The development of massive steam-powered machinery forced merchants to centralize labor inside urban factories. (大型蒸汽動力機械的發展，迫使商人將勞動力集中在城市工廠內部。)
The technology firm adopted a customer-centric business model to maximize user satisfaction and loyalty. (該科技公司採用了以客戶為中心的商業模式，以最大化使用者滿意度與忠誠度。)
The lead scientist declared with absolute certitude that the experimental drug was safe for human clinical trials. (首席科學家以絕對的把握宣布，該實驗藥物對人體臨床試驗是安全的。)
The sudden cessation of heavy annual monsoon precipitation triggered an immediate collapse in lowland agrarian maize crops. (每年強烈季風降雨的突然停止，引發了低地農業玉米作物的即時崩潰。)
Much to his chagrin, his proposal was rejected by the board. (令他大為懊惱的是，他的提案被董事會否決了。)

meaning: 白堊的、粉質的、石灰質的
example: The agricultural researchers determined that the crop's roots were struggling due to the dry, chalky soil condition. (農業研究人員認定，由於乾燥、白堊質的土壤條件，該作物的根部生長困難。)
Historically, a ship chandler was responsible for supplying vessels with essential provisions before long voyages. (在歷史上，船舶雜貨商負責在遠航前為船隻供應必要的物資。)
The factory experienced a temporary drop in productivity during the rapid changeover to automated machinery. (工廠在快速切換為自動化機械的過程中，生產力出現了暫時性的下降。)
Atmospheric storm cells inside the hyper-arid core of the plateau are intrinsically chaotic, making nowcasting models speculative. (高原極度乾旱核心內部的大氣風暴單元在本質上是混沌的（混亂的），使得現在預報模型具有投機性。)
Vehicles moved chaotically through the intersection during the major power outage that disabled the traffic lights. (在導致交通號誌失效的大停電期間，車輛混亂地穿過十字路口。)

meaning: 通俗小冊子（早期廉價刊物）
example: The chapbook functioned as an affordable medium that popularized oral folklore and satires among working-class laborers. (通俗小冊子扮演了一種負擔得起的媒介角色，在工人階級勞工中普及了口頭民間傳說與諷刺文學。)
The intense heat of the forest fire will quickly char the trunks of even the largest redwood trees. (森林大火的強烈高溫會迅速將哪怕是最大的紅杉樹幹燒成炭。)
Realist writers abandoned romanticized character frameworks, prioritizing the gritty, gritty, naturalistic characterization of factory laborers. (寫實主義作家放棄了浪漫化的角色框架，優先考慮對工廠勞工進行真實、自然主義的角色塑造（特徵描繪）。)
The political leader possessed an extraordinary level of charisma that captivated voters across the political spectrum. (這位政治領袖擁有非凡的個人魅力，吸引了不同政治立場的選民。)

meaning: 有魅力的；有神授能力的
example: The charismatic revolutionary leader successfully unified several disparate political factions under one banner. (這位富有魅力的革命領袖成功地將幾個不同的政治派別統一在一個旗幟下。)
The venture capital firm is notoriously chary of investing in unproven software startups. (這家創投公司對於投資未經證實的軟體新創公司，向來表現得非常謹慎。)
The classic monastery was built in a chaste architectural style entirely devoid of superfluous ornamentation. (這座古典修道院是以一種完全沒有多餘裝飾的簡樸建築風格建造的。)
The European mercantile aristocracy built grand stone chateau edifices featuring detailed geometric ornamentation. (歐洲商業貴族階級建造了宏偉的石造城堡（豪宅）大廈，以精細的幾何裝飾為特色。)
The steam engine allowed manufactured commodities to be transported cheaply across extensive rail networks. (蒸汽機使得製造商品得以廉價地跨越廣大的鐵路網路進行運輸。)
The constant cheep of vulnerable nestlings signals parent birds to return immediately with gathered insect food. (脆弱雛鳥持續的唧唧聲，提示鳥爸媽立即帶著採集到的昆蟲食物返回。)

meaning: 陰沉的、無生氣的、令人沮喪的
example: The abandoned industrial complex presented a cheerless landscape under the grey winter sky. (這座被遺棄的工業園區在灰色冬日天空下，呈現出一幅令人沮喪的陰沉景象。)
Acid rain chemically alters limestone buildings, breaking down calcium carbonate into soluble compounds. (酸雨從化學上改變了石灰岩建築，將碳酸鈣分解為可溶性化合物。)
The boutique hotel was praised for its chic interior design, blending minimalist aesthetics with historic elements. (這家精品酒店因其時髦的室內設計而受到讚譽，將極簡主義美學與歷史元素完美融合。)
The prehistoric pueblo dwellings were constructed chiefly from localized sandstone and sundried adobe bricks. (史前普埃布洛住宅主要由當地的砂岩和日曬土坯磚建造而成。)
Arthropods secrete structural proteins to stiffen their newly formed chitin exoskeletons immediately after they molt. (節肢動物在換羽（脫皮）後會立即分泌結構蛋白質，以使其新形成的幾丁質外骨骼變硬。)

meaning: 騎士風度的；對女性尊重的
example: His chivalrous behavior was highly appreciated by everyone at the party. (他在派對上富有騎士風度的舉止受到了大家的高度讚賞。)
Oral storytelling epic histories compiled by medieval scribes frequently romanticized medieval codes of elite military chivalry. (由中世紀書吏編纂的口頭說故事史詩歷史，經常將精英軍事騎士精神的中世紀規範浪漫化。)
A severe deficiency of potassium or iron in the soil can trigger chlorosis, causing plant leaves to pale. (土壤中嚴重缺乏鉀或鐵會引發植物萎黃病，導致植物葉片變白。)
Herbivorous dinosaurs would chomp through prodigious volumes of dense gymnosperm foliage daily. (食草性恐龍每天會大聲咀嚼巨大數量的密集裸子植物葉子。)
A chondrite is a primitive stony meteorite containing tiny spherical mineral spheres known as chondrules. (球粒隕石是一種原始的石隕石，含有被稱為球粒的微小球狀礦物顆粒。)
Each individual chondrule crystallized rapidly within the dusty nebula before condensing into early stony asteroids. (在濃縮成早期的石質小行星之前，每個單獨的球粒在多塵的星雲中快速結晶。)
Ethologists observe that female migratory finches are exceptionally choosy when selecting nesting coordinates inside canopies. (行為學家觀察到，雌性遷徙雀鳥在樹冠內部選擇築巢座標時是格外挑剔（慎重選擇）的。)
The small ferry struggled to navigate across the choppy waters of the bay during the thunderstorm. (在雷雨中，這艘小渡輪艱難地在海灣波浪起伏的水面上航行。)
The artistic director was hired to choreograph the complex dance routines for the Broadway musical production. (這位藝術總監受聘為這部百老匯音樂劇製作編排複雜的舞蹈動作。)
The modernist choreographer rejected classical ballet formats, introducing naturalistic body gestures into the performance. (這位現代主義編舞家拒絕了古典芭蕾的形式，將寫實的身體姿態引入表演中。)
The modernist theatre performance featured abstract choreography that integrated naturalistic gestures and pantomime metrics. (現代主義劇場演出的特徵是抽象的編舞（藝術），融合了寫實的身體姿勢與啞劇指標。)
Down syndrome is typically caused by the presence of an extra copy of chromosome 21 in an individual's DNA. (唐氏症通常是由於個體DNA中存在第21對染色體的額外副本所引起的。)
Sumerian clay mud tablets survive to chronicle localized crop allocations, agricultural taxes, and legal guild disputes. (蘇美黏土泥板倖存下來，記錄了（編年史）局部的作物分配、農業稅收以及合法的公會糾紛。)

meaning: 年代學、年表、事件發生的順序
example: The historian established a strict chronology of the events leading up to the declaration of global conflict. (歷史學家為引發全球衝突宣言的事件，確立了嚴格的發生順序年表。)

meaning: 持續發出發動機排氣聲；（火車/船）緩慢行進
example: Early steam freighter vessels began to chug across transatlantic seaways, stabilizing commercial trade networks. (早期的蒸汽貨輪船隻開始持續發出發動機排氣聲（緩慢行進）跨越橫跨大西洋的航道，穩固了商業貿易網絡。)
Strong oceanic currents cause the water to churn violently near the rocky coastline. (強烈的洋流導致岩石海岸附近的海水劇烈翻滾。)
Frontier homesteaders gathered wild orchard apples to ferment rich batches of organic fruit cider during winter. (拓荒農莊主採集野生果園的蘋果，以便在冬季發酵釀製出豐富的有機水果蘋果酒。)

meaning: 密碼；暗號；微不足道的人
example: The military intelligence department worked tirelessly to crack the complex enemy cryptographic cipher. (軍事情報部門孜孜不倦地工作，以破解複雜的敵軍密碼。)

meaning: 晝夜節律的；生理時鐘的
example: The circadian rhythm regulates critical physiological actions, matching an organism's sleep cycle with daylight. (晝夜節律調節著關鍵的生理活動，使生物體的睡眠週期與日光相匹配。)
Regular cardiovascular exercise is highly beneficial for maintaining a healthy circulatory system. (規律的有氧運動對於維持健康的血液循環系統非常有益。)
The historic citadel stood atop the rocky mountain, acting as a defensive refuge for the townspeople. (這座歷史悠久的城堡耸立在岩石山頂，充當城鎮居民的防禦避難所。)

meaning: 齊特琴（一種古老弦樂器）
example: The folk musician performed an evocative melody on a traditional European cither during the cultural heritage festival. (在文化遺產節期間，這位民間音樂家用傳統的歐洲齊特琴演奏了一首令人動容的旋律。)
The ancient clavichord possessed a minuscule acoustic dynamic range, suitable only for private parlor recitals. (古代的翼琴具備微小的聲學動態範圍，僅適合私人沙龍獨奏會。)
Archeologists discovered fragments of ancient utilitarian clayware buried near the prehistoric settlement site. (考古學家在史前定居點遺址附近發現了埋藏的古代實用陶器碎片。)
The clement weather of the Mediterranean region supports the cultivation of olives and grapes. (地中海地區溫和的氣候支持了橄欖和葡萄的耕作。)
In medieval metropolitan centers, the scholarly elite class consisted principally of Latin-writing literate clergy. (在中世紀的大都市中心，學術精英階層主要由用拉丁文寫作的、具備文化素養的神職人員組成。)
Climatic variations, such as prolonged droughts, can precipitate the sudden collapse of agrarian societies. (氣候變異（例如長期乾旱）可能會加速農業社會的突然崩潰。)
In the mid-nineteenth century, the American merchant clipper was renowned for its unprecedented transoceanic speed. (在十九世紀中期，美國商用快速帆船以其前所未有的跨洋速度而聞名。)
The museum exhibits a collection of masterfully crafted timepieces created by an eighteenth-century Swiss clockmaker. (博物館展出了一系列由十八世紀瑞士鐘錶匠精湛製作的鐘錶收藏。)
Accumulated hair and soap scum can easily clog the bathroom drain, causing water to back up. (累積的頭髮和肥皂垢很容易阻塞浴室排水管，導致水流倒灌。)
In semiarid grasslands, vegetation tends to clump around localized subsurface groundwater upwelling deposits. (在半乾旱草原中，植被往往會圍繞在地表下地下水局部湧出的沉積區聚集成群。)
The raised coaming around the cockpit effectively prevented splashing waves from flooding the small sailboat. (座艙周圍加高的防水圍板有效防止了飛濺的波浪淹沒這艘小帆船。)
A specialized anti-reflective coating was applied to the optical lenses to maximize light transmission. (光學鏡片上塗覆了一層專業的防反射塗層，以最大化光線的穿透率。)
The mother managed to coax her reluctant toddler into eating the nutritious vegetable soup. (母親成功地哄騙她不情願的幼童吃下營養豐富的蔬菜湯。)
In algebra, a coefficient is a numerical or constant quantity placed before and multiplying a variable. (在代數中，係數是放在變數前面並與之相乘的數值或常數。)
Centralized political administrations inside early chiefdoms could coerce labor forces to erect monumental statuary. (早期酋邦內部的中央集權政治行政當局，能強迫勞動力去豎立宏偉的雕像。)
Two distinct predator species can coexist in the same ecosystem if they adapt to exploit separate prey niches. (如果兩種不同的捕食者物種適應於利用不同的獵物生態棲位，牠們就可以在同一個生態系統中共存。)
Avian species like crows demonstrate high cognitive capacities, such as tool fabrication and problem-solving. (像烏鴉這樣的鳥類展現出極高的認知能力，例如工具製造和解決問題。)
The legal and economic rights of couples in long-term cohabitation vary significantly across different states. (長期同居伴侶的法律與經濟權利在不同的州之間有很大的差異。)
The leader's fragmented arguments failed to cohere into a logical and persuasive political platform. (這位領導人零碎的論點未能凝聚成一個具邏輯性且有說服力的政治政綱。)
The argumentative essay lacked structural coherence, making it extremely difficult for the readers to follow. (這篇論說文缺乏結構上的連貫性，使得讀者非常難以理解。)
The communal sharing of agricultural resources boosted social cohesion within the ancestral pueblo settlements. (農業資源的公社共享，增強了祖傳普埃布洛定居點內的社會凝聚力。)
The Iroquois Confederacy relied on a collaborative political council setup to formalize inter-tribal maritime trade rules. (易洛魁聯盟依賴一個合作的政治議會編制，來使跨部落的海上貿易規則正式化。)
The textbook author acted as a close collaborator with the marine biologist to map out oceanic plankton biomes. (教科書作者與海洋生物學家充當緊密的合作者，以繪製海洋浮游生物群系的圖譜。)
Fibrous connective tissues inside mammalian skeletal frameworks are composed heavily of stable, elongated collagen arrays. (哺乳動物骨骼骨架內部的纖維連接組織，主要由穩定的、延伸的膠原蛋白陣列所組成。)
The field researchers utilized collapsible solar panels that could be easily transported in backpacks. (野外研究人員利用了可以輕鬆用背包攜帶的可折疊太陽能板。)
The modern fashion designer showcased a collection of sleek, collarless jackets suitable for casual corporate wear. (這位現代服裝設計師展示了一系列時尚、無領的外套，適合休閒的企業穿著。)
Each early colonist faced immense hardships, including severe winters and unfamiliar agricultural conditions. (每位早期殖民者都面臨著巨大的艱難，包括嚴酷的寒冬和不熟悉的農業條件。)
The biological colonization of a newly formed volcanic island begins with wind-dispersed seeds and spores. (一座新形成的火山島的生物拓殖，是從隨風散播的種子和孢子開始的。)
Pioneer plant species are the first to colonize barren landscapes after a catastrophic volcanic eruption. (在毀滅性的火山爆發後，先驅植物物種是最先在荒蕪景觀中拓殖的。)
Lichen functions as a pioneer biological colonizer, anchoring inside microscopic crevice fractures of bare granite blocks. (地衣充當先驅的拓殖生物，錨定在裸露花崗岩塊微小的裂縫內部。)
The bright iridescent green head coloration of the mallard drake acts to attract camouflaged female birds. (綠頭公鴨鮮豔虹彩光澤的綠色頭部天然顏色，起到吸引具保護色偽裝的雌鳥的作用。)
The traditional festival participants were colorfully dressed in embroidered garments that reflected their ancestry. (傳統節日的參與者們色彩鮮豔地穿著反映其祖先傳承的刺繡服裝。)
Xenon is a colorless, odorless gaseous element that glows with a brilliant light under electrical excitation. (氙氣是一種無色、無味的氣態元素，在電子激發下會發出鮮豔的光芒。)
The archeologists discovered the ruins of a colossal monument dedicated to an ancient Egyptian pharaoh. (考古學家發現了一座獻給古埃及法老的巨大紀念碑遺跡。)

meaning: 哥倫布的；美洲發現時期的
example: The Columbian Exchange led to a massive global redistribution of agricultural products, pests, and diseases. (哥倫布大交換導致了全球農業產品、害蟲和疾病的大規模重新分布。)
The comet's luminous coma expands as solar radiation vaporizes the underlying icy core during its approach. (當彗星接近時，太陽輻射蒸發了底層的冰凍核心，使其發光的彗髮發生膨脹。)
The monkey's comical behavior amused the crowd of children gathered around the zoo enclosure. (猴子滑稽的行為逗樂了聚集在動物園圍欄周圍的孩子們。)
The religious sect adhered strictly to every traditional moral commandment formulated by their ancestral shaman. (該宗教派別嚴格遵守由其祖傳薩滿所闡明的每一條傳統道德誡命。)
The symbiotic alliance between a shark and a remora fish represents a classic commensal interaction where the host is unaffected. (鯊魚與鮣魚之間的共生同盟，代表了一種經典的片利共生互動，其中宿主完全不受影響。)
Commensalism describes an alliance where one organism benefits while the other remains entirely unaffected. (片利共生描述了一種同盟關係，其中一種生物受益，而另一種生物則完全不受影響。)
The nineteenth-century expansion of intercity rail routes triggered the immediate commercialization of midwest agricultural surpluses. (十九世紀城市間鐵路路徑的擴張，引發了中西部農業剩餘產品立即的商業化。)
The industrial laboratory utilized a heavy mechanical mill to comminute the quartz mineral samples into fine powder. (工業實驗室利用沉重的機械磨機，將石英礦物樣本磨碎成細粉。)
The artists decided to live in a rural commune to share resources. (藝術家們決定生活在農村公社中以共享資源。)
The structural compactness of the compacted snow block blocks allows an Inuit igloo to trap inner core thermal warmth efficiently. (緊實雪塊結構的緊密性（緊湊），容許因紐特雪屋有效地鎖住內部核心的熱量溫暖。)
Sedentary agriculturalist groups built multi-story stone masonry pueblos that were comparably complex to Mediterranean citadels. (定居的農業勞動者群體建造了多層石造建築普埃布洛村落，其複雜程度與地中海城堡同等（可比較）。)
The court awarded substantial compensatory damages to the victim to cover all medical expenses and lost wages. (法院判給受害者大筆補償性損害賠償金，以支付所有的醫療費用和工資損失。)
The compositional parameters of stony chondrites offer direct insights into primitive solar system nebula dust. (石質球粒隕石的成分參數，為原始太陽系星雲塵埃提供了直接的洞察。)
Neolithic agriculturalists combined decomposing foliage with animal manure to generate mineral-rich planting compost. (新石器時代的農業勞動者將分解的葉子與動物糞便結合，以製造出富含礦物質的種植堆肥。)
Gases are highly compressible because their particles are widely spaced. (氣體是高度可壓縮的，因為它們的粒子間距很大。)
Tectonic compression at convergent boundaries forces land crustal layers upward, forming massive folded mountain ranges. (在聚合板塊交界處的地殼壓縮迫使陸地殼層向上，形成宏偉的褶皺山脈。)
Early optical experiments utilized a concave mirror to concentrate light rays into a highly localized focal zone. (早期的光學實驗利用一個凹面鏡，將光線聚焦到一個高度局部化的焦點區域。)
Under extreme pressure models, it is conceivable that subsurface rock layers plastically deforms rather than fracturing cleanly. (在極端壓力模型下，地表下岩石層發生塑性變形而非乾脆地斷裂，是完全可想像的（可能的）。)
Under immense pressures, subsurface granite rock units could conceivably undergo ductile plastic deformation. (在巨大的壓力下，地表下的花崗岩石單元可想像地可能會經歷具延展性的塑性變形。)

meaning: 六角風琴；手風琴的一種
example: The itinerant vaudeville performer handcraft acoustic melodies using a portable concertina device inside urban fairgrounds. (巡迴的綜藝雜耍表演者在城市的露天遊藝場內部，利用可攜式六角風琴裝置手工演奏出聲音旋律。)
The diplomat made an effort to conciliate the opposing factions. (外交官努力安撫反對派系。)
The medieval alchemist attempted to concoct an elixir using basic lead ores and volatile chemical fluids. (中世紀的鍊金術士企圖利用基礎鉛礦石與揮發性化學流體來調配出一種長生不老藥。)
Rapid industrialization inside the factory metropolis provoked a concomitant elevation in severe occupational health hazards. (工廠大都市內部的快速工業化，引發了嚴重職業健康傷害同時發生（伴隨）的攀升。)
The nations signed a peace treaty to restore concord in the region. (各國簽署了和平條約以恢復該地區的和諧。)
Atmospheric clouds materialize when invisible subsurface water vapor undergoes condensation around microscopic airborne granules. (當看不見的地表下水蒸氣圍繞著空氣中微小的微粒進行凝結時，大氣雲彩就會具體顯現。)
The industrial steam engine utilizes an isolated cooling condenser mechanism to efficiently turn spent gas back into fluid. (工業蒸汽機利用一個隔離的冷卻冷凝器機制，以有效地將消耗的氣體轉化回液體。)
Ketchup is arguably the most ubiquitous condiment used in fast-food restaurants across North America. (番茄醬可以說是北美速食店中最無所不在的調味品。)
Diplomats from around the world gathered at the embassy to condole with the citizens after the national tragedy. (國家悲劇發生後，來自世界各地內的外交官聚集在大使館，向公民們表達慰問與弔唁。)
A quiet, well-lit study environment is highly conducive to effective learning and academic productivity. (安靜、光線充足的學習環境非常有利於有效的學習與學術生產力。)
Copper is widely utilized in industrial electronics due to its exceptional thermal and electrical conduction properties. (銅因其卓越的熱傳導與電傳導特性，被廣泛應用於工業電子中。)

meaning: 科內斯托加式大篷車（早期美國拓荒大馬車）
example: Pioneer families relied on the heavy Conestoga wagon to transport their handcraft tools and furniture across western plains. (拓荒家庭依賴笨重的科內斯托加式大篷車，跨越西部平原運輸他們的手工工具與家具。)
The Iroquois Confederacy was a highly sophisticated political alliance consisting of distinct indigenous tribes. (易洛魁聯盟是一個由不同原住民部落組成的、高度複雜的政治聯盟。)
The politician relied on his lifelong childhood friend as a trusted confidant during times of severe political crisis. (在嚴重的政治危機時期，這位政治人物依賴他終生的童年好友作為值得信賴的知己。)
Linguistic scholars warn researchers not to conflate cuneiform structural referents with abstract ideographic inscriptions. (語言學學者警告研究人員，不要將楔形文字的結構指示物與抽象的表意文字銘文混淆（合併）。)
The ancient trading city was strategically established at the confluence of two major navigable rivers. (這座古老的貿易城市被策略性地建立在兩條主要通航河流的匯流處。)
The behavioral study examined the powerful psychological mechanisms that drive social conformity in groups. (這項行為研究探討了驅使群體中社會遵從的強大心理機制。)

meaning: 意氣相投的；舒適的；適宜的
example: The clement Mediterranean climate represents an exceptionally congenial ecosystem for the systematic horticulture of olives and ferns. (溫和的地中海氣候，代表了一個對於橄欖與蕨類植物系統化園藝來說異常適宜的（舒適的）生態系統。)
Heavy traffic began to congest the narrow streets of downtown. (沉重的交通開始使市中心狹窄的街道變得擁擠。)
Without direct radiocarbon dating or organic artifact extractions, current chronologies for the Paleolithic site remain purely conjectural. (在缺乏直接放射性碳定年或有機文物提取的情況下，目前關於該舊石器時代遺址的年代記仍純屬推測的。)
The delicious aroma managed to conjure up memories of his childhood home. (誘人的香氣成功喚起了他對童年家鄉的回憶。)
Fibrous connective tissues provide anatomical stability, anchoring mammalian muscles firmly to skeletal bones. (纖維連接組織提供了解剖學上的穩定性，將哺乳動物的肌肉堅固地錨定在骨骼上。)
An aristocratic connoisseur of classical Mediterranean antiquity could quickly distinguish authentic glazed statuary arts. (一位古典地中海古代藝術的貴族行家（鑑定家），能迅速辨別真實的塗釉雕像藝術。)
The word 'home' tends to connote comfort, warmth, and complete safety. (「家」這個詞往往意味著舒適、溫暖和完全的安全感。)
The nation introduced mandatory military conscription during the height of the geopolitical crisis. (該國在地緣政治危機最嚴重的時候，推出了強制性的軍隊徵兵制度。)
The prominent conservationist dedicated her life to protecting endangered marine species in the Pacific Ocean. (這位著名的自然保護主義者致力於保護太平洋中的瀕危海洋物種。)
The continuous compression and compaction of loose mudbed granules leads directly to the geological consolidation of shale rock layers. (鬆散泥床微粒持續的壓縮與壓實作用，直接導致了頁岩岩石層的地質壓實（整合/鞏固）。)

meaning: 結交；配偶；陪伴（常與 consort with 連用）
example: Ecologists observe that migratory finches rarely consort with separate bird species inside the same canopy understory niche. (生態學家觀察到，遷徙的雀鳥很少與同一個樹冠林下植物層生態棲位內部的其他獨立鳥類物種結交（陪伴）。)
Cold polar marine currents can constrict peripheral blood vessels in seals to minimize core thermal dissipation. (寒冷的極地洋流會使海豹的周邊血管收縮，以將核心熱量耗散降到最低。)
The snake constricted its muscles to trap its prey tightly. (蛇收縮肌肉以緊緊困住獵物。)
Alaska is not one of the forty-eight contiguous states of America. (阿拉斯加不屬於美國本土的四十八個相鄰州。)
The persistence of the outwork piecework setup marked a continuation of preindustrial manufacturing economic tracks. (家庭代工計件工作編制的持續存在，標記了工業化前製造業經濟軌跡的持續（繼續）。)
The evolutionary theorist acted as a brilliant continuator of Darwinian science, mapping out genetic mutualism parameters. (這位演化理論家充當了達爾文科學的傑出繼續者，繪製出了基因互利共生參數的圖譜。)
The modern geographer tracked the precise elevation contour lines detailing tectonic crustal uplift across the rugged alp. (現代地理學家追蹤了詳細記錄多石高山跨度內板塊地殼抬升的精確海拔等高線（輪廓）。)
Thermal contraction happens when molten magma cools rapidly inside crustal fractures, generating dense crystalline rock. (當熔融岩漿在地殼裂縫內部快速冷卻時會發生熱收縮，產生緻密的結晶岩。)
Excessive phosphorus agricultural runoff was a major contributory factor triggering toxic alga blooms. (過量的磷農業逕流是引發有毒藻類大量增殖的核心促成因素。)
Thermal convection loops inside Earth's deep molten mantle drive the long-term tectonic displacement of lithospheric plates. (地球深處熔融地函內部的熱對流循環，驅動了岩石圈板塊長期的地殼構造位移。)
The convergent evolution of ichthyosaurs and dolphins highlights a functional convergence driven by marine propulsion mechanics. (魚龍與海豚的趨同演化，突出了由海洋推進力學所驅動的功能匯聚（趨同）。)
The technical engineer designed a mechanical energy converter to transform waterpower into industrial electricity. (技術工程師設計了一個機械能量轉換器，以將水力轉化為工業電力。)
A convex lens converges light rays to a focal point, a principle essential for early camera optics. (凸透鏡將光線匯聚到一個焦點上，這是早期相機光學必不可少的原理。)
The neighborhood organized an annual summer cookout in the local park to foster community relationships. (鄰里在當地公園組織了一年一度的夏季野餐戶外烤肉聚會，以促進社區關係。)
During historical cooler periods like the Little Ice Age, crop failures led to widespread demographic crises. (在歷史上較為涼爽的時期（如小冰河期），作物歉收導致了廣泛的人口危機。)

The early artisan coppersmith manufactured utilitarian water jugs and ornamental figurines from crude copper ores. (早期的工匠銅匠利用粗糙的銅礦石，製造出了實用性的水罐與裝飾性的小雕像。)

meaning: 鞋匠（通常指製作高級皮鞋者）
example: The master cordwainer spent weeks meticulously crafting the bespoke leather boots by hand. (這位高級鞋匠花了數週的時間，手工精心製作這雙訂製皮靴。)

The early Broadway theater orchestra integrated the brass cornet to boost the acoustic dynamic amplification of the performance. (早期的百老匯劇院管弦樂團融入了黃銅短號，以增強演出的聲學動態放大效果。)
Economic decline is a natural corollary of prolonged political instability. (經濟衰退是長期政治不穩定的必然結果。)

meaning: 法人、公司、軍團（常為縮寫）

meaning: 肉體的；物質的；有形體的

Linguists analyze the entire surviving corpus of Sumerian cuneiform inscriptions to chart the evolution of early text simplification. (語言學家分析了整個現存的蘇美楔形文字文字全集，以繪製早期文字簡化的演化圖表。)
The cowboys worked efficiently together to corral the wandering cattle before the heavy storm hit. (牛仔們高效合作，在大暴雨來臨前將游蕩的牛群趕入畜欄。)
Neurologists theorize that the cerebral cortex dictate complex cognitive generalization habits inside mammalian primates. (神經學家推論，大腦皮質主導著哺乳動物靈長類內複雜的認知概括習慣。)

The countercurrent heat exchange system in wading birds prevents core heat loss through their uninsulated legs. (涉禽體內的逆流熱交換系統可防止核心熱量透過未受絕緣保護的雙腿流失。)
Male mallard drakes engage in dynamic courtship vocalizations, flashing iridescent head plumage to attract camouflaged female birds. (雄性綠頭公鴨進行動態的求偶發聲，閃現虹彩光澤的頭部羽毛以吸引具保護色偽裝的雌鳥。)
The experienced cowhand managed the massive herd of cattle across the rugged terrain of the ranch. (這位經驗豐富的牧工在牧場崎嶇的地形上管理著龐大的牛群。)
The master craftsman spent months carving the intricate wooden doors for the newly restored cathedral. (這位大師級工匠花了數月時間，為新修復的大教堂雕刻錯綜複雜的木門。)
Highly specialized craftspeople in ancient urban centers created luxury artifacts for the ruling elite. (古代城市中心高度專業的手工藝人，為統治精英製作奢侈工藝品。)
The evolutionary record of the genus Homo tracks a dramatic enlargement of cranial capacity across successive generations. (人屬的演化記錄追蹤了接連世代中顱骨容量的劇烈擴大。)
The fitness craze of the late 1980s led to a dramatic increase in suburban health club memberships. (1980年代後期的健身狂熱，導致郊區健身俱樂部會員人數急劇增加。)
The extraction of pristine transitional hominid footprints inside fresh volcanic ash layers granted empirical credence to bipedal theories. (在新鮮火山灰層內部挖掘出原始的過渡原始人類足跡，為雙足步行理論賦予了經驗上的信任（憑證）。)
Critics argue that credentialism places too much emphasis on formal degrees. (批評者認為，文憑主義過於強調正式學位。)
The university's foundational charter guarantees equal opportunity to all applicants regardless of race, gender, or creed. (該大學的創始憲章保障所有申請者享有平等機會，不論其種族、性別或宗教信條為何。)
The hikers successfully reached the rocky crest of the mountain ridge just as the sun began to rise. (登山客在太陽剛剛升起之時，成功抵達了山脊的岩石頂峰。)
The Cretaceous period concluded with a mass extinction event that wiped out the non-avian dinosaurs. (白堊紀以一場大規模滅絕事件結束，該事件清除了非鳥類的恐龍。)
Lichens can colonize bare granite by anchoring securely inside a microscopic stone crevice. (地衣能透過在微小的石頭裂縫內牢固地錨定，從而拓殖裸露的花崗岩。)
The artisan mixed ground iron oxide minerals to produce a brilliant crimson pigment glaze for decorating the ceremonial earthenware urn. (工匠混合磨碎的氧化鐵礦物，製造出鮮豔的深紅色顏料釉料，用以裝飾儀式用土器甕。)

meaning: 造成嚴重傷害的；令人癱瘓的
example: The economic sanctions had a crippling effect on the nation's manufacturing sector, leading to widespread inflation. (經濟制裁對該國的製造業造成了癱瘓性的打擊，導致了普遍的通貨膨脹。)
Intercity rail lines began to crisscross the midwest plains, integrating peripheral farmlands into urban metropolis markets. (城市間的鐵路線開始縱橫交錯於中西部平原，將周邊的農田整合進城市大都市市場。)
Railroad tracks criss-cross the country, connecting major urban centers. (鐵路軌道縱橫交錯全國，連接主要城市中心。)

meaning: 關鍵地；批判性地；危急地
example: The reproductive survival of the endangered owl population depends critically on preserving old-growth timberline reserves. (這群瀕危貓頭鷹族群的繁殖生存，關鍵地取決於保護古老原始的林木線自然保護區。)
The professor wrote a detailed critique of the newly published economic theory. (教授對新發表的經濟理論寫了一篇詳細的評論。)
Paleolithic toolmakers crudely hammered raw flint blocks against granite boulders to extract sharp scraping shards. (舊石器時代的工具製造者，粗糙地將原始燧石塊撞擊花崗岩巨石，以提取出鋒利的刮削碎片。)

meaning: 十字軍東征；改革運動；奮鬥

Igneous rocks have a crystalline texture that forms as molten magma cools and solidifies beneath Earth's surface. (岩漿岩具有結晶狀的紋理，這是熔融岩漿在地球表面下冷卻並凝固時形成的。)
Her vague ideas began to crystallize into a concrete business plan. (她模糊的想法開始具體化為一個具體的商業計劃。)
A bovine ruminant continuously chews its cud to facilitate the bacterial breakdown of rigid plant cellulose. (牛科反芻動物不斷地咀嚼牠的反芻食物，以促進細菌分解僵硬的植物纖維素。)
The investigation concluded that the manager was culpable for the leak. (調查得出結論，經理對這次洩漏事件負有責任。)
The historic landmark is regarded as a culturally significant site that must be preserved for future generations. (這處歷史地標被視為一個在文化上極具意義的遺址，必須為子孫後代保存下來。)
Early preindustrial steam powered machinery was highly inefficient and cumbersome, requiring massive wooden fuel volumes. (早期工業化前的蒸汽動力機械非常無效率且笨重，需要龐大的木材燃料體積。)
Sumerian scribes developed cuneiform writing, pressing wedge-shaped stencils into wet clay tablets. (蘇美書吏發展出了楔形文字，將楔形的型版壓入潮濕的泥板中。)
The natural hot springs are rumored to possess curative powers that relieve chronic joint pain. (傳聞天然溫泉具有治病的功效，能緩解慢性關節疼痛。)

meaning: （博物館、美術館等的）館長；策展人
example: The museum curator cataloged an exceptionally preserved collection of Neolithic earthenware and stone stencils. (這位博物館館長登記了一批保存格外完好的新石器時代土器陶器與石頭模板。)
The eccentric collector filled his study with rare curios gathered from his travels across East Asia. (這位古怪的收藏家在書房裡擺滿了他東亞之行中所收集到的稀有古玩。)
The young dancer made a polite curtsy to the audience after the show. (年輕的舞者在演出結束後向觀眾行了禮貌的屈膝禮。)
Marine biologists observed that specific blue-green alga blooms reflect a distinct cyan wavelength under sunlight. (海洋生物學家觀察到，特定的藍綠藻大量增殖在陽光下會反射出獨特的青色波長。)
The cyclical eccentricity adjustments of Earth's orbital path paths control the long-term cyclic glaciation loops of eras. (地球軌道路徑週期性的離心率調整，控制了多個時代長期週期的（循環的）冰河作用循環。)
Early phonographs relied on a rotating cylindrical tinfoil sleeve to capture and reproduce acoustic vibrations. (早期的留聲機依賴一個旋轉的圓柱形錫箔套筒，來捕捉並重現聲音震動。)

meaning: 銀版攝影法（早期攝影術）
example: The introduction of the daguerreotype captured individual human profiles with a precision that manual portrait artists could not match. (銀版攝影法的引進以手工肖像藝術家無法比擬的精確度，捕捉到了單個人類的輪廓特徵。)
The open meadow was filled with bright yellow and white daisy flowers. (開闊的草地裡長滿了鮮黃色和白色的雛菊花。)
Thick overcast clouds can significantly dampen solar radiation levels, decreasing daily photosynthetic output in ferns. (濃厚的陰雲會顯著減弱（抑制）太陽輻射水平，降低蕨類植物每天的光合作用產量。)

meaning: 阻尼器；減震器；抑制因素
example: Persistent overirrigation deposits toxic alkali minerals, acting as a direct economic damper on crop maturation phases. (持續的過度灌溉沉積了有毒的鹼性礦物質，充當了作物成熟階段一個直接的經濟抑制因素。)
The dandelion utilizes wind-assisted dispersal, with its lightweight seed tufts traveling miles away from the parent plant. (蒲公英利用風力輔助的散播方式，其輕量的種子絨毛能傳播到距離親代植物數英里遠的地方。)
Dense forest foliage layers dapple the oncoming incoming sunlight solar rays, creating dim lighting profiles understories. (茂密的森林葉子層使射入的太陽光線長斑駁點（斑駁交錯），在林下植物層創造出微弱的照明特徵。)
Massive atmospheric injections of volcanic ash can drastically darken the sky, blocking solar rays for consecutive months. (大氣中大量注入的火山灰會劇烈使天空變暗，連續數月阻擋太陽光線。)
Deep ocean cave dwellers adapt to absolute darkness by losing functional eyes and developing tactile organs. (深海洞穴居民透過失去功能性的眼睛並發展觸覺器官，來適應絕對的黑暗。)
In times of economic hardship, families would carefully darn worn clothing rather than purchasing new garments. (在經濟艱難的時期，家庭會仔細地織補破舊的衣物，而不是購買新的衣服。)

Radiocarbon dating serves as an essential chronological tool for pinpointing the exact antiquity timeline of organic artifacts. (放射性碳定年法是精確查明有機文物古老時間線不可或缺的年代學工具。)
The diamond ring gave off a dazzling reflection under the spotlight. (鑽石戒指在聚光燈下發出耀眼的光芒。)
The young pianist performed the intricate concerto dazzlingly, earning a standing ovation from the audience. (這位年輕的鋼琴家令人耀眼地演奏了這首複雜的協奏曲，贏得了全場觀眾的起立鼓掌。)

The lifestyle of the late empire was seen as overly decadent. (帝國晚期的生活方式被認為是過度頹廢的。)
The geometric pattern on the moth's wing acts as an evolutionary deception designed to confuse predatory birds. (蛾類翅膀上的幾何圖案扮演著演化偽裝手段的角色，旨在混淆捕食性鳥類。)
The marketing campaign was penalized for its highly deceptive claims regarding the health benefits of the supplement. (該行銷活動因其對補充劑健康益處的高度欺騙性宣稱而受到處罰。)
A deciduous forest experiences seasonal dormancy, with trees shedding leaves during autumn to conserve vital fluids. (落葉林經歷季節性休眠，樹木在秋季落葉以保存至關重要的水分。)

meaning: 裝飾藝術風格 (Art Deco 的簡稱)

The biological study observed how the animals defecate to mark territory. (這項生物學研究觀察了動物如何排便以標記領地。)

Arid atmospheric dryness can swiftly dehydrate vulnerable amphibian skin cells unless they secrete protective mucus. (乾旱的大氣乾燥會迅速使脆弱的兩棲動物皮膚細胞脫水，除非牠們分泌保護性的黏液。)
The ancestral pueblo shaman invoked a powerful supernatural deity to bring rainwater to their semiarid farmlands. (祖傳普埃布洛薩滿祈求一位強大的超自然神，為他們半乾旱的農田帶來雨水。)
The culinary arts institute prepared a array of delectable desserts for the annual fundraising gala. (烹飪藝術學院為年度募款晚宴準備了一系列美味可口的甜點。)
Stratigraphic surveys help delineate the precise geological boundary markers separating the Mesozoic and Cenozoic eras. (地層調查有助於描繪（勾勒）分隔中生代與新生代的精確地質邊界標記。)

A river delta forms when sediment-laden river water enters a stagnant ocean basin, slowing down and dropping its load. (當載滿沉積物的河水進入停滯的海洋盆地時，水流減速並放下其負載，進而形成河流三角洲。)
The student received a demerit for failing to submit the mandatory research assignment on time. (該學生因未能按時繳交強制的研究作業而被記了一次過。)

Rapid industrialization provoked a sweeping demographic transition, relocating rural families into urban factory zones. (快速工業化引發了全面的人口結構轉變，將農村家庭重新安置到城市工廠區域。)
The minor car accident left a noticeable dent in the front bumper. (這起輕微的車禍在前保險桿上留下了一個明顯的凹痕。)
The continuous ecological dependence of a specialized parasite on a single host species increases its vulnerability to extinction. (特化寄生蟲對單一宿主物種的持續生態依賴，增加了其滅絕的脆弱性。)

International leaders gathered to deplore the violent acts of terrorism. (國際領導人聚集在一起譴責恐怖主義的暴力行為。)
The revolutionary military council voted to depose the tyrannical dictator and establish a provisional government. (革命軍事委員會投票決定廢黜暴虐的獨裁者，並建立臨時政府。)
River delta formations are driven by the persistent deposition of silt transported from highland mountain regions. (河流三角洲的形成是由從高山山區運送過來的粉砂持續沉積所驅動的。)

The supreme court ruled to desegregate public schools across the country. (最高法院裁定廢除全國公立學校的種族隔離。)

Persistent atmospheric desiccation forces succulent desert plants to seal their microscopic leaf conductance pores. (持續的大氣乾燥作用迫使多肉沙漠植物關閉其微小的葉片導度氣孔。)
The invading soldiers proceeded to despoil the ancient temples of their treasures. (入侵的士兵開始掠奪古代寺廟的寶藏。)
Prolonged climatic droughts left agrarian farmers despondent as successive crop failures depleted stored seed resources. (長期的氣候乾旱使農業農民感到沮喪，因為接連的作物歉收耗盡了儲存的種子資源。)

The military garrison commander deployed a small detachment of soldiers to secure the shallow frontier river ford. (衛戍部隊指揮官部署了一小支士兵分隊，以確保淺淺的邊境河流淺灘的安全。)

meaning: 惡化；退化（動詞第三人稱單數）
example: When persistent overirrigation anomalies occur, soil mineralization matrix profiles deteriorate, transforming fields into sterile lands. (當持續的過度灌溉異常發生時，土壤礦化作用基質特徵就會惡化（退化），將田地轉化為貧瘠的土地。)
Annual rainfall predictability stands as the primary ecological determinant governing whether a grassland biome accelerates into desertification. (年降雨量的可預測性，堪稱支配大草原生物群系是否加速發生沙漠化的核心生態決定因素。)
The two political rivals detest each other and refuse to cooperate. (這兩位政治對手互相憎惡，拒絕合作。)
Slight geometric irregularities in early earthenware pottery do not detract from its exceptional historic value. (早期土器陶器上微小的幾何不規則性，並不會減損其卓越的歷史價值。)
Despite facing severe skepticism from every academic detractor, the geologist's continental drift theory was eventually validated. (儘管面臨來自每位學術貶低者的嚴厲質疑，地質學家的大陸漂移學說最終獲得了證實。)
The catastrophic asteroid collision concluded the Cretaceous era, causing global ecological devastation and faunal extinction. (毀滅性的小行星撞擊結束了白堊紀時代，造成全球生態的毀滅（破壞）與動物群滅絕。)
A child's developmental timeline is strongly dictated by the gradual maturation of specialized cognitive neural pathways. (兒童的發展時間線，受到特化認知神經通路逐漸成熟的強烈支配。)
The hyper-arid core of the plateau is virtually devoid of vegetation, consisting entirely of rocky terrain. (該高原極度乾旱的核心地區幾乎完全缺乏植被，完全由岩石地形組成。)
The devout followers gathered at the sacred temple every dawn to offer traditional morning prayers. (虔誠的信徒們每到黎明都會聚集在神聖的寺廟裡，進行傳統的晨禱。)
The pianist’s dexterous fingers moved effortlessly across the keys. (鋼琴家靈巧的手指在琴鍵上輕鬆地移動。)
The ancestral pueblo potters embellished earthenware jars with sharp diagonal lines etched using bone fragments. (祖傳普埃布洛陶工利用骨頭碎片刻劃出尖銳的對角線條，來裝飾土器罐子。)
The sociological essay explores the false dichotomy between traditional agrarian lifestyles and modern urban existence. (這篇社會學文章探討了傳統農業生活方式與現代城市存在之間的錯誤二分法。)
The actor's clear diction and precise vocal articulation ensured that every word reached the back of the theater. (演員清晰的咬字與精確的發音發聲，確保每個字都能傳到劇場的最後方。)
The company offers a differential pay scale based on years of experience. (公司根據多年的經驗提供有差別的薪資福利。)

meaning: 擴散；傳播（動詞第三人稱單數）
example: As solar radiation diffuses through the comet's volatile coma, gaseous particles glow with brilliant fluorescent coloration. (當太陽輻射擴散穿過彗星具有揮發性的彗髮時，氣態顆粒會發出鮮豔的螢光色彩。)
The cultural diffusion of maize cultivation transformed nomadic hunter-gatherers into stationary, agrarian societies. (玉米耕作的文化傳播將游牧的狩獵採集者轉化為定居的農業社會。)
Oxygen difluoride is a highly reactive chemical compound that must be handled with extreme laboratory caution. (二氟化氧是一種極具活性、必須在實驗室中極其謹慎處理的化學化合物。)
Ruminants possess a specialized digestive tract containing symbiotic bacteria to break down rigid plant cellulose. (反芻動物擁有特化的消化道，內含共生細菌以分解僵硬的植物纖維素。)
The historical library launched an ambitious initiative to digitize millions of rare, decaying manuscripts. (這座歷史悠久的圖書館啟動了一項雄心勃勃的計畫，將數百萬份珍稀、腐蝕中的手稿數位化。)
The university chosen to dignify the event by inviting three world-renowned Nobel laureates as speakers. (該大學選擇邀請三位享譽世界的諾貝爾獎得主擔任演講嘉賓，以增添該活動的尊榮。)
The professor's lengthy digression about his personal vacation confused students during the physics lecture. (在物理課上，教授關於他個人度假的冗長離題讓學生們感到困惑。)

Economists observed a gradual diminution of consumer spending following the implementation of the sales tax. (經濟學家觀察到，在實施營業稅後，消費者支出逐漸減少。)
The formal dining hall of the university features grand architecture reminiscent of the Gothic era. (該大學的正式宴會廳擁有讓人聯想到哥德時代的宏偉建築風格。)
Plants absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis and release oxygen back into the environment. (植物在光合作用過程中吸收二氧化碳，並將氧氣釋放回環境中。)
A permanent depletion of deep underground aquifers carries dire subsistence consequences for farmlands across arid zones. (深層地下含水層的永久枯竭，對乾旱地區跨度間的農田帶來了極其嚴重的維持生存後果。)
The directional migration of migratory birds across thousands of miles is synchronized via Earth's magnetosphere. (候鳥跨越數千英里的方向性遷徙，是透過地球磁層來同步化的。)
The rapid evolutionary radiation of angiosperms was tightly synchronized with the structural disappearance of old gymnosperm forests. (被子植物快速的演化輻射適應，與古老裸子植物森林的結構性消失高度同步。)
His warm and sincere smile managed to disarm the angry customer. (他溫暖而誠摯的笑容成功消除了憤怒顧客的敵意。)
Toxic alkali mineral crusts deposited by overirrigation anomalies can completely discolor and degrade organic topsoil fields. (過度灌溉異常沉積的有毒鹼性礦物地殼，會完全使有機表土田地變色並降解。)
The pale chlorosis discoloration displayed on broadleaf foliage indicates a critical deficiency of soil iron and potassium. (闊葉樹葉子上顯示的蒼白萎黃病變色，顯示出土壤中嚴重缺乏鐵與鉀。)
The unexpected change in the interview format threatened to disconcert the otherwise well-prepared job applicant. (面試形式突如其來的變化，差點讓原本準備充分的求職者感到心慌意亂。)
The state's imposition of permanent centralized agricultural taxes sparked sweeping discontent among peripheral rancher tribes. (國家強加永久性的集中農業稅，在外圍的牧場主部落中引發了全面的不滿（不平）。)
The geologists noted a sharp structural discontinuity in the rock layers, indicating ancient seismic activity. (地質學家注意到岩層中存在明顯的結構不連續性，這預示著古代的地震活動。)
The academic anthropologist drafted an extensive written discourse evaluating social stratification criteria inside early chiefdom confederacies. (這位學術人類學家起草了一篇廣泛的書面論述（論文），評估早期酋邦聯盟內部的社會分層標準。)
The discoverer of the ancient Mayan stone tablet meticulously documented each cuneiform-like hieroglyph profile. (這位古代馬雅石碑的發現者，細心地記錄了每個類似楔形文字的象形文字輪廓。)
Traditional academic art institutions initially expressed intense disdain toward the naturalistic formulas of impressionist painters. (傳統的學術藝術機構最初對印象派畫家的寫實（自然主義）公式表現出強烈的輕蔑（蔑視）。)

meaning: 使消除習慣化（恢復對刺激的反應）
example: Ethologists observed that a sudden hostile vocalization can instantly dishabituate wild birds to human observer parameters. (動物行為學家觀察到，突然的敵對發聲能立即消除野生鳥類對人類觀察者參數的習慣化（恢復警覺反應）。)
Discovering corruption within the administrative ranks served to disillusion many young idealistic idealists. (發現行政高層內部的腐敗，使許多年輕的理想主義者的幻想破滅。)
The ideal judge must display complete disinterest in the financial outcomes of the corporate litigation. (理想的法官必須對這起公司訴訟的財務結果表現出完全的公正無私。)

meaning: 公正的；無私利的；不感興趣的
example: A judge must remain an entirely disinterested party throughout the trial to guarantee a fair legal outcome. (法官在整個審判過程中必須保持完全無私利的公正第三方身分，以保證公平的法律結果。)
The strong seismic tremors managed to dislodge massive boulders from the unstable mountain peak. (強烈的地震震動成功使巨大的巨石從不穩定的山峰上移走並滾落。)
Within stratified feudal confederacies, political disloyalty by a peripheral chief was penalized via resource withholding. (在分層的封建聯盟內部，周邊酋長政治上的不忠會受到扣押資源的懲罰。)
The two scientists held disparate views on the origins of the universe. (這兩位科學家對宇宙的起源持有截然不同的觀點。)
The medical board released a comprehensive report to dispel public rumors regarding the vaccine's safety. (醫學委員會發布了一份全面報告，以消除大眾對於疫苗安全性的謠言。)
Seed dispersal by wind requires lightweight structures like wings or tufts to maximize airborne travel. (透過風力進行的種子散播，需要像翅膀或絨毛這樣的輕量結構，以最大化空中飛行距離。)
Geopolitical conflicts frequently cause the mass displacement of civilian populations across international borders. (地緣政治衝突經常導致平民人口跨越國際邊境的大規模流離失所。)
A disproportionate share of mercantile wealth was controlled by a small elite tier of aristocratic urban merchants. (商業財富中不成比例的份額，被一小群貴族城市商人的精英階層所控制。)
Paleontologists discovered fresh transitional fossils that completely disprove the static, unchanging species theory. (古生物學家發現了新的過渡化石，完全反駁了靜態、不變的物種理論。)
The sudden change in leadership caused widespread disquiet among employees. (領導層的突然更迭引發了員工的廣泛不安。)
Sweeping protectionist trade codes imposed by the state acted to dissatisfy peripheral mercantile outwork capitalists. (國家實施的全面保護主義貿易法規，使外圍的商業家庭代工資本家感到不滿意。)
The expansion of affordable automated printing presses allowed early publishers to rapidly disseminate political satires to laborers. (可負擔得起的自動化印刷機的擴張，容許早期的出版商向勞工迅速傳播（散播）政治諷刺作品。)
The authoritarian government moved decisively to suppress any prominent political dissenter within the state. (極權政府採取果斷行動，以鎮壓國內任何著名的政治異議者。)
The politician attempted to dissimulate his intense disappointment with a forced, cheerful smile for the cameras. (這位政治人物企圖用一個面向鏡頭的勉強、開朗微笑來掩飾他強烈的失望。)
The young heir led a dissolute life before turning his focus to the family business. (這位年輕的繼承人在將注意力轉向家族事業之前，過著放蕩的生活。)
The predatory beetle developed chemical compounds that render its soft tissues highly distasteful to foraging birds. (這種捕食性甲蟲發展出了化學化合物，使其軟組織對覓食的鳥類來說顯得高度令人反感（難以下嚥）。)
Each separate volcanic eruption sequence leaves a chemically distinctly signature inside the local sediment strata layers. (每次獨立的火山爆發序列，都會在當地的沉積地層內留下化學上顯著不同的特徵。)
The chemosynthetic bacteria inside deep seafloor hydrothermal vents leave a chemically distinguishable mineral signature. (深海海床熱泉內部的化化能合成細菌，留下了化學上可辨別的礦物特徵。)
The old railroad tracks fell into disuse after the construction of the modern interstate highway system. (在現代州際公路系統建設完工後，舊的鐵軌便陷入了廢棄不用的狀態。)

meaning: 歌劇女主角；知名女歌星
example: The growth of grand metropolis theater entertainment elevated the legendary opera diva into a highly paid celebrity elite. (宏偉大都市劇院娛樂產業的成長，將傳奇的歌劇女主角推崇為高薪的知名精英。)
The loon is an expert avian diver, capable of staying submerged for minutes while pursuing agile fish. (潛鳥是專家級的潛水鳥，能夠在追捕敏捷的魚類時保持潜水數分鐘。)
Molecular tracking of DNA sequences maps out the exact timeline marking the genomic divergence of Homo sapiens from Neanderthals. (DNA序列的分子追蹤，繪製出了標記智人與尼安德塔人基因體演化趨異（分開）的確切時間線。)

meaning: 分歧的；分開的；（演化）趨異的
example: Molecular tracking of DNA sequences map the divergent evolutionary paths of modern primates. (DNA序列的分子追蹤，繪製出了現代靈長類分歧的（趨異的）演化路徑。)
The ancient Mayan diviner interpreted celestial alignment maps platforms to predict seasonal rain drops recharges. (古代馬雅占卜者（預言家）解讀天體對齊地圖平台，以預測季節性的降雨補給。)
Through dogged determination and years of hard work, the scientist finally discovered a vaccine for the disease. (憑藉著頑強的決心與多年的努力，這位科學家終於發現了該疾病的疫苗。)
Despite facing severe financial setbacks, the entrepreneurial team doggedly pursued their technological research. (儘管面臨嚴重的財務挫折，該創業團隊仍頑強地追求他們的技術研究。)

meaning: 茱萸；大花茱萸（顯花樹木）
example: The white dogwood is a common broadleaf angiosperm tree that thrives inside the cool understory of temperate woodland landscapes. (白茱萸是一種常見的闊葉被子植物樹木，在溫帶林地景觀涼爽的林下植物層內部茂盛生長。)
The nation aims to produce enough renewable energy domestically to eliminate its reliance on petroleum imports. (該國旨在國內生產足夠的再生能源，以消除對石油進口的依賴。)
Neolithic agriculturalists worked to domesticate wild einkorn grains by selecting seeds that firmly adhered to stems. (新石器時代的農業勞動者藉由篩選牢固附著在莖上的種子，來努力馴化野生單粒小麥穀物。)
The domestication of wild grains required ancient agriculturalists to select for non-shattering seed pods. (野生穀物的馴化需要古代農業勞動者篩選出不會自動爆裂的種莢。)
The lawyer established his permanent domicile in the city of Taipei. (這位律師在台北市建立了永久居所。)
Before entering the contaminated chamber, the laboratory biologists had to don protective hazmat suits. (在進入受污染的艙室之前，實驗室生物學家必須穿上防護衣。)

Fungal spores can remain completely dormant inside arid sandstone crevices until seasonal water returns. (真菌孢子可以在乾旱的砂岩裂縫內部保持完全休眠，直到季節性水分返回。)
The grandparents tend to dote excessively on their only granddaughter, purchasing her numerous expensive toys. (祖父母往往過分溺愛他們唯一的外孫女，為她購買無數昂貴的玩具。)
The downside of living in a major city is the extremely high cost of living. (居住在大城市的大缺點就是極高的生活成本。)
Heavy autumn leaves clogged the residential drainpipe, causing rainwater to overflow into the basement. (厚重的秋季落葉堵塞了住宅的排水管，導致雨水溢流到地下室。)
The male mallard drake displays bright, iridescent green head plumage to attract camouflaged female birds. (雄性綠頭公鴨展現出明亮的、具虹彩光澤的綠色頭部羽毛，以吸引具保護色偽裝的雌鳥。)
Before heading out into the freezing winter night, the traveler drank a small dram of whiskey to warm up. (在走向寒冷的冬夜之前，這名旅人喝了一小口威士忌來暖和身體。)
The vaudeville theatrical performers chose to dramatize popular historic legends to entertain illiterate urban laborers. (綜藝雜耍劇場表演者選擇將受歡迎的歷史傳說戲劇化演出，以娛樂無文化素養的城市勞工。)

meaning: 褶飾（雕刻或畫作中衣服的褶皺）
example: The naturalist Greek sculptor paid meticulous attention to the organic flow of carved stone drapery on the statue. (這位自然主義希臘雕刻家對雕刻石像上衣服褶飾的有機流動，給予了細心的關注。)
Clouds are formed when invisible water vapor condenses around microscopic airborne particles to form a water droplet. (當看不見的水蒸氣圍繞著空氣中的微小顆粒凝結形成水滴時，雲就形成了。)
Xerophytic succulents display extreme tolerance to persistent atmospheric dryness, storing rainwater inside stems. (旱生多肉植物對持續的大氣乾燥表現出極高的耐受性，將雨水儲存在莖內部。)
Specialized glands utilize a tiny anatomical duct to secrete volatile trail pheromones directly onto soil surfaces. (特化的腺體利用微小的解剖導管，將具揮發性的足跡費洛蒙直接分泌到土壤表面上。)
The thyroid is classified as a ductless gland belonging to the endocrine system, secreting regulatory hormones directly into bloodstreams. (甲狀腺被歸類為屬於內分泌系統的無導管腺體，將調節荷爾蒙直接分泌到血流中。)
The European mercantile duke controlled lucrative shipping monopolies, funding monumental urban architectural edifices. (這位歐洲商業公爵控制著獲利豐厚的航運壟斷，資助了宏偉的城市建築大廈。)
Coastal vegetation plays a critical ecological role in stabilizing the sand dune systems against wind erosion. (沿海植被在穩定沙丘系統免受風蝕方面，發揮了關鍵的生態作用。)
The scammers managed to dupe dozens of investors out of their life savings. (詐騙分子成功欺騙了數十名投資者，騙走了他們的畢生積蓄。)
The interlocking crystalline texturing of plutonic granite generates immense structural strength and historic durability. (深成花崗岩相互鎖緊的結晶紋理，產生了巨大的結構強度與歷史耐久性。)
The cave dweller populations adapted their tools to navigate the dark and cold conditions of their shelters. (洞穴居民調整了他們的工具，以適應其庇護所黑暗且寒冷的環境。)
Urban audiences eagerly crowded early arcades to view moving frames inside the newly invented mutoscope. (城市觀眾渴望地擠滿早期的遊藝場，以觀看新發明的連續放映機內部的動態畫面。)
Before industrial centralize trends expanded, each skilled outwork weaver functioned as an independent wage earner. (在工業集中化趨勢擴張之前，每位熟練的家庭代工編織工都充當獨立的工資賺取者。)
The young researcher's manifest earnestness convinced the committee to grant financial backing for the project. (這位年輕研究員所展現出的顯著認真態度，說服了委員會為該專案提供資金支持。)
The corporation reported a record-breaking increase in quarterly earnings due to strong international sales. (由於強勁的國際銷售，該公司報告了創紀錄的季度收益增長。)
Earthenware is fired at lower temperatures than stoneware, making it porous unless covered with a glaze. (陶器比石器在更低的溫度下燒製，這使其具有多孔性，除非塗上釉料。)
Astronomers measure the cyclical eccentricity of Earth's orbital path to calculate historical interglacial timelines. (天文學家測量地球軌道路徑的週期性離心率（偏心率），以計算歷史上的間冰期時間線。)

Early cinema pioneers engaged in constant technical experimentation, sequencing frames to perfect projector mechanics. (早期的電影開創者進行了不斷的技術實驗，串聯畫面以完善放映機的機械結構。)
The Neolithic craftspeople expertly manipulated handheld flint stencils to incise uniform geometric lines into damp earthenware. (新石器時代的手工藝人熟練地（專家向地）操縱手持的燧石模板，在潮濕的土器上雕刻出均勻的幾何線條。)
The commercial exploitation of aquifer water reserves must be legally regulated to prevent deep water table collapse. (對含水層水儲量的商業開採利用，必須受到法律監管以防止深層地下水位崩潰。)
The robotic rover conducted exploratory drilling into the Martian bedrock matrix, locating subsurface deposits of sulfate gypsum. (機器人探測車對火星基岩基質進行了探索性的鑽探，查明了地表下硫酸鹽石膏的沉積位置。)

meaning: 倡導者；支持者；（數學）指數
example: Thomas Cole was a leading exponent of naturalism painting, capturing pristine wilderness expanses. (湯姆·科爾是自然主義繪畫的核心倡導者，捕捉了原始的荒野廣闊空間。)

meaning: 指數級的；（增長）越來越快的
example: The nineteenth-century expansion of intercity rail networks fueled an exponential growth in urban metropolitan demographics. (十九世紀城市間鐵路網路的擴張，推動了城市大都市人口呈指數級的快速增長。)
The spy maintained an expressionless face during the interrogation, revealing no emotional clues to the agents. (間諜在審訊過程中保持著毫無表情的面孔，沒有向探員透露任何情感線索。)
The naturalistic Greek statuary was celebrated for its physical expressiveness, capturing realistic anatomical curves and bone lines. (寫實的（自然主義）希臘雕像因其身體的表現力而聞名，捕捉了寫實的解剖曲線與骨骼線條。)
The municipal government decided to expropriate private land along the riverbank to construct a public highway. (市政府決定徵收沿河岸的私人土地，以建造一條公共公路。)
Volcanic ash contains minerals that have been extensively used to enhance soil fertility in valleys. (火山灰含有已被廣泛用於增強山谷土壤肥力的礦物質。)
The extensive conversion of temperate forests into farmlands triggered the near-extermination of the native beaver. (將溫帶森林廣泛轉變為農田的做法，引發了原生河狸的幾乎近乎絕滅。)
Environmental pollution is considered a classic negative externality in modern capitalistic economics. (環境污染在現代資本主義經濟學中被視為一個經典的負面外部效應。)
Realist biographers often extol the virtuosity of artisans who rejected mass industrialization formats. (寫實主義傳記作者經常讚美那些拒絕大規模工業化形式的工匠的精湛技藝。)
The gang attempted to extort money from the local business owners. (該幫派企圖向當地商家勒索金錢。)
The commercial extraction of groundwater from aquifers must not exceed the natural annual recharge rate. (從含水層中進行地下水的商業開採，絕不能超過每年的天然補給率。)
The preservation of organic leaf imprints inside fine shale bedrock is extraordinarily rare, requiring immediate anaerobic burial. (細緻頁岩基岩內部有機葉片印記的保存是異常罕見的，需要立即進行厭氧埋藏。)
The historical monarch spent extravagantly on building opulent palaces while the agrarian economy suffered. (這位歷史上的君主在建造豪奢宮廷上奢侈地花費，而此時農業經濟卻遭受重創。)
Extrinsic motivation, such as money, is not always effective for long-term retention. (外在動機（例如金錢）對於長期留任並不總是有效。)

meaning: 茂盛的；精力充沛的；（藝術）華麗的
example: The tropical rainforest understory experiences dim sunlight but supports an exuberant growth of broadleaf ferns and mosses. (熱帶雨林林下植物層雖然陽光微弱，卻支持著闊葉蕨類與苔蘚茂盛的生長。)
The historical biographer analyzed every surviving eyewitness account to reconstruct the paintmaker's authentic profile. (歷史傳記作者分析了每一個現存的目擊者敘述，以重塑這位畫家的真實輪廓。)
The Art Deco skyscrapers of the metropolitan metropolis featured bold geometric ornamentation carved directly into the stone facade. (大都市摩天大樓的特徵是，將前衛的幾何裝飾直接雕刻到石造建築正面（外表）上。)
Behind his calm professional façade, the executive was experiencing immense stress regarding the company's future. (在他冷靜專業的外表假象之下，這位主管正承受著對公司未來的巨大壓力。)
The research library holds a high-quality facsimile of the original 1215 Magna Carta for academic study. (該研究圖書館收藏了1215年大憲章原件的高品質摹本，供學術研究之用。)
Historical research must rely on factual evidence extracted from primary sources rather than conjecture. (歷史研究必須依賴從一手史料中提取的事實證據，而非推測。)
The early peepshow machines were distributed across urban fairground zones, attracting crowds of working-class laborers. (早期的西洋鏡機器被分佈在城市的露天遊藝場區域，吸引了大量的工人階級勞工。)
The expert falconer utilized trained peregrine falcons to intercept flying avian prey with high-velocity diving traits. (專家級獵鷹者利用訓練有素的遊隼，以高速俯衝的特徵來攔截飛行的鳥類獵物。)
The refugees were famished after wandering through the desert for days. (難民在沙漠中徘徊數日後飢寒交迫。)
The dictator relied on a group of fanatical supporters to maintain tight control over the entire country. (獨裁者依靠一群狂熱的支持者來維持對整個國家的嚴密控制。)
Early speculative hypotheses regarding life on Venus were highly fanciful, describing tropical swamps hidden beneath acidic clouds. (早期關於金星上存在生命的投機性假設是高度富於幻想的，描述了隱藏在酸性雲層下方的熱帶沼澤。)
Astronomers utilize space telescopes to capture high-resolution imagery of faraway galaxies. (天文學家利用太空望遠鏡來捕捉遙遠星系的高解析度影像。)
The theater troupe performed a fast-paced political farce that utilized extreme exaggeration to critique the aristocracy. (該劇團演出了一齣節奏快速的政治鬧劇，利用極度的誇張手法來批判貴族階級。)
Critics argued that the sci-fi movie's plot was entirely far-fetched and defied basic physical laws. (評論家認為這部科幻電影的劇情完全牽強附會，且違背了基本的物理定律。)
The migratory farmhand relocated across regions depending on the seasonal harvesting cycles of major fruits. (這位流動農場工人根據主要水果的季節性採收週期在不同地區之間遷移。)
The widespread conversion of forests into fertile farmland triggered substantial regional ecological changes. (將森林廣泛轉變為肥沃農田的做法，引發了巨大的區域生態變化。)
The political architects of the confederacy made a farsighted decision to formalize unified trade regulations across tribes. (該聯盟的政治設計師做出了一個有遠見的決定，將跨部落的統一貿易法規正式化。)

meaning: 講究的；挑剔的；（生物）需要特定特殊營養的
example: A fastidious marine alga species can only replicate inside landlocked waters possessing specific salinity balances. (一種對環境講究的海洋藻類物種，只能在具備特定鹽度平衡的內陸水域中進行複製。)
Early oceanographers had to drop heavy lead weights to fathom the absolute depths of deep maritime basins. (早期的海洋學家不得不放下沉重的鉛錘，以探測（噚量）深海盆地的絕對深度。)
Migratory birds forage relentlessly to fatten their physiological reserves before starting expansive oversea flights. (候鳥在開始廣闊的海外飛行之前，會無休止地覓食以使牠們的生理儲備肥厚起來。)
A major faunal shift happened at the Cretaceous boundary when terrestrial dinosaurs vanished completely. (在白堊紀邊界發生了一次重大的動物群轉變，當時陸地恐龍完全消失了。)
The investigative journalist was celebrated for her fearless reporting on systemic political corruption. (這位調查記者因其對系統性政治腐敗的大膽無畏報導而受到讚譽。)
The predatory dinosaur possessed a fearsome array of razor-sharp teeth designed for tearing meat. (這種肉食性恐龍擁有一組可怕且鋒利如剃刀的牙齒，專為撕裂肉塊而設計。)
The upper atmosphere was decorated with light, feathery cirrus clouds that signaled an approaching front. (高層大氣中點綴著輕柔如羽毛般的卷雲，預示著鋒面的逼近。)

meaning: 毫無特色的、平坦單調的
example: The polar expedition traversed a vast, featureless landscape of pure white snow and ice for weeks. (極地探險隊在純白冰雪構成、一望無際且平坦單調的景致中橫越了數週。)
The post-glacial thaw transformed the frozen steppe plain into a highly fecund, fertile livable agricultural valley. (冰河期後的融化，將冰凍的大草原平原轉化為一個高度肥沃的（多產的）、適合居住的農業山谷。)

meaning: 聯邦制支持者的；聯邦黨人的聯邦政府的
example: The Whig party leaders aligned with federalist political guidelines, draft infrastructure bills to fund midwest transcontinental railways. (輝格黨領袖符合聯邦政府的（聯邦制支持者的）政治方針，起草基礎設施法案以資助中西部橫貫大陸鐵路。)
The student decided to feign illness to avoid taking the difficult test. (這名學生決定裝病以避免參加困難的考試。)

meaning: 抵擋；供養（常與 fend for oneself 連用）
example: Altricial avian hatchlings cannot fend for themselves inside the open forest understory canopy, requiring continuous parent care. (晚熟性的鳥類剛孵化的雛鳥在開闊的森林林下植物層樹冠內部無法自力更生（自給自足/供養自己），需要持續的親代照顧。)
Yeast is used to ferment sugar into alcohol during beer production. (在啤酒生產過程中，酵母被用來將糖發酵成酒精。)
A fern reproduces via spores rather than seeds, thriving in damp, shaded forest understories. (蕨類植物透過孢子而非種子進行繁殖，在潮濕、陰暗的森林底層茂盛生長。)
Marine invertebrates rely on synchronized spawning to maximize the probability of successful external egg fertilization. (海洋無脊椎動物依賴同步產卵，以最大化外部卵子成功受精的機率。)
The political activist spoke with an intense fervor that deeply inspired the gathered assembly. (政治活動家以強烈的熱情發言，深深激勵了聚集在一起的集會群眾。)
Medical biologists monitor the mammalian fetus inside the womb to trace early cranial and skeletal maturation phases. (醫學生物學家監測子宮內的哺乳動物胎兒，以追蹤早期的顱骨與骨骼成熟階段。)
The satiric writer drafted a fictional kingdom to mask critiques aimed at the ruling aristocratic administration. (這位諷刺作家虛構了一個王國，以掩飾針對統治貴族行政當局的批判。)

meaning: 野石；散石（天然建築石材）
example: Pioneer colonists constructed sturdy agricultural homesteads using unshaped fieldstone cleared from their fields. (拓荒殖民者利用從田中清理出來的未塑形野石，建造了堅固的農業農莊。)
The political candidate delivered a fiery speech that ignited passion and enthusiasm among his supporters. (這位政治候選人發表了一篇慷慨激昂的演講，點燃了支持者的熱情。)
Neolithic cave artwork transitioned from abstract lines toward figural depictions that clearly mapped hunting groups and bisons. (新石器時代的洞穴藝術品從抽象線條過渡到具象的描繪，清晰映射出狩獵群體與野牛。)
Neolithic artwork transitioned toward figurative styles that explicitly depicted human hunting groups and animals. (新石器時代的藝術品轉向具象風格，明確描繪了人類狩獵群體與動物。)
The oral storyteller utilized narrative metaphors figuratively to convey complex tribal legal systems to children. (口頭說故事者形象化地利用敘事隱喻，向兒童傳達複雜的部落法律制度。)
Paleolithic cultures crafted small clay figurines that likely carried symbolic or ritualistic significance. (舊石器時代文化工藝製作了小型泥塑小雕像，這些小雕像可能具有象徵性或儀式性的意義。)
Thomas Edison experimented with thousands of materials before discovering that a carbonized bamboo filament worked efficiently in lightbulbs. (湯瑪斯·愛迪生在發現碳化竹絲能在燈泡中有效運作之前，曾對數千種材料進行過實驗。)
In many Asian cultures, filial piety is regarded as a fundamental virtue. (在許多亞洲文化中，孝道被視為一種基本的傳統美德。)
The early film pioneer was a creative filmmaker who utilized cinematic projectors to display animated sequences to public crowds. (早期的電影開創者是一位極具創意的電影製作人，他利用電影放映機向公眾群眾展示動畫序列。)
A filmy layer of morning mist hung low over the surface of the lake, obscuring the distant shoreline. (薄薄一層如膜般的晨霧低低地懸掛在湖面上，遮蔽了遙遠的海岸線。)
The private turnpike projects were financially unsustainable without persistent state intervention and subsidies. (如果沒有國家持續的干預和補貼，私營的收費公路計畫在財政上是無法永續的。)
Each island finch population adapted its beak structure to exploit distinct seeds, avoiding direct competition. (每個島嶼上的雀鳥群體都調整了其喙部結構以利用不同的種子，從而避免了直接競爭。)
Music historians analyze the wear on the ebony fingerboard of ancient lutes to understand historical playing techniques. (音樂歷史學家分析古代魯特琴烏木指板上的磨損，以了解歷史上的演奏技巧。)
The introduction of the mechanized firearm transformed inter-tribal warfare configurations across preindustrial territories. (機械化槍械的引進，改變了工業化前領地內跨部落戰爭的格局。)
The glowing meteoric fireball split across the nighttime sky, leaving an identifiable path recorded by astronomers. (發光的隕石火球劃破夜空，留下了一條被天文學家記錄下來的可識別路徑。)
The chemical vitrification of stoneware clay glaze happens during the high-temperature firing phase inside airtight kilns. (炻器黏土釉料的化學玻璃化，發生在密閉窯內的高溫燒製階段。)
The ancestral pueblo dwellings were anchored firmly into the steep sandstone cliffs for strategic military defense. (祖傳普埃布洛住宅被堅固地錨定在陡峭的砂岩懸崖上，以進行戰略性的軍事防禦。)
As layers of annual snowfall accumulate and compress, snow recrystallizes into a dense intermediate state called firn. (隨著每年降雪層的累積和壓縮，雪會重新結晶成一種稱為粒雪的緻密中間狀態。)
The military garrison erected a tall cedar flagpole inside the center of the frontier fortress complex. (衛戍部隊在邊境堡壘建築群的中心內部，豎立了一根高大的雪松木旗桿。)
The young fashion designer has a unique flair for combining modern street styles with traditional textiles. (這位年輕的服裝設計師在將現代街頭風格與傳統紡織品相結合方面，有著獨特的天賦。)
During the freezing winter months, wearing a heavy flannel shirt helps retain body heat effectively. (在寒冷的冬季，穿著厚實的法蘭絨襯衫有助於有效保持體溫。)
The chemist utilized an airtight glass flask to isolate volatile gases released during putrefaction. (化學家利用一個密閉的玻璃燒瓶，來分離腐爛過程中釋放出的揮發性氣體。)

meaning: 平底船（內河航運大木船）
example: Before steamboats expanded across the midcontinent, merchants manually steered heavily laden flatboat models down rivers. (在汽船跨越中部大陸擴張之前，商人手工駕駛著載滿貨物的平底船模型順流而下。)
Neolithic craftspeople cultivated flax, processing the plant's fibrous stems to weave the earliest linen textiles. (新石器時代的手工藝人耕作亞麻，處理該植物的纖維莖以編織出最早的亞麻織品。)
Nomadic pastoralist communities migrate flexibly across the semiarid steppe landscape according to seasonal rain variations. (游牧的畜牧社群根據季節性的降雨變異，靈活地（具彈性地）跨越大草原半乾旱景觀進行遷移。)
Paleolithic toolmakers utilized bone tools to knap raw flint blocks into sharp symmetrical scraping shards. (舊石器時代的工具製造者，利用骨製工具將原始燧石塊敲擊成鋒利的對稱刮削碎片。)

meaning: 鰭足；（海豹、海龜等的）鰭狀肢
example: The evolutionary transition from a walking limb to a swimming flipper allowed marine mammals to exploit ocean niches. (從步行肢到游泳鰭狀肢的演化轉變，使得海洋哺乳動物能夠利用海洋生態棲位。)
Persistent river overflow events deposit fertile silt layers across the flat agricultural floodplain biome. (持續的河流氾濫事件，在平坦的農業洪泛平原（河漫灘）生物群系跨度上沉積了肥沃的粉砂層。)
The recurring floral motif embroidered onto the linen chapbook sleeve indicates a cultural reverence for spring biomes. (繡在亞麻通俗小冊子套筒上反覆出現的花卉圖案，顯示了對春季生物群系的文化崇敬。)
The professional florist sourced rare exotic orchids from international nurseries for the botanical exhibition. (專業花商從國際溫室中採購罕見的外來蘭花，用於植物展覽。)
Orchid horticulturists utilize rich planting compost layers inside each stylized flowerbed to attract specialized insect pollinators. (蘭花園藝家在每個風格化的花壇內部，利用豐富的種植堆肥層來吸引特定的昆蟲授粉者。)
The botanist arranged several experimental seedlings in separate clay flowerpots within the temperature-controlled nursery. (植物學家在溫控溫室中將幾株實驗性幼苗排列在獨立的泥製花盆中。)
Homeowners must clean the chimney flue regularly to prevent dangerous accumulations of flammable creosote. (屋主必須定期清理煙囪煙道，以防止易燃的可燃物危險堆積。)
Avian hatchlings inside cold polar tundras are covered in dense fluffy down feathers to insulate their core metabolic warmth. (寒冷極地凍原內部的鳥類剛孵化的雛鳥覆蓋著密集的蓬鬆絨羽，以隔離其核心的新陳代謝溫暖。)
The discovery of the pristine fossil bed was a complete fluke driven by unexpected highway construction. (這處原始化石層的發現完全是一個僥倖，是由意外的公路建設所促成的。)
The tech industry is currently in a state of constant flux due to rapid advancements in artificial intelligence. (由於人工智慧的飛速發展，科技產業目前正處於不斷變遷的狀態。)

meaning: 微不足道之物；蠅點；污點
example: Under powerful optical microscopy, the primitive chondrule inclusion inside the meteorite appeared as a mere flyspeck. (在強大的光學顯微鏡下，隕石內部的原始球粒內含物看起來只不過是一個微不足道的蠅點。)
The Mississippi flyway is a critical geographical route for millions of migratory birds traveling across North America. (密西西比遷徙路線是數百萬隻穿梭於北美洲的候鳥至關重要的地理路線。)
Economic growth remains the focal point of the government’s presentation. (經濟增長仍然是政府報告的中心焦點。)
The campaign aims to focalize public attention on climate change. (該活動旨在將大眾的注意力集中在氣候變遷上。)
Pastoralist communities gathered wild steppe grasses to store as winter fodder for their domesticated livestock herds. (畜牧社群採集野生大草原牧草，以儲存作為其馴養牲畜獸群的冬季飼料。)
Herbivorous Mesozoic dinosaurs consumed prodigious volumes of dense gymnosperm foliage daily to survive. (中生代食草恐龍每天消耗巨大數量的密集裸子植物葉子以生存。)
The academic journal published a comprehensive analysis of the folkloric traditions of the Appalachian region. (該學術期刊發表了一篇對阿帕拉契地區民俗傳統的全面分析。)
Building a massive coastal resort on a rapidly eroding shoreline was ultimately recognized as an economic folly. (在快速侵蝕的海岸線上建造巨大的海岸度假村，最終被公認為一項經濟上的愚蠢行為。)
Acorns functioned as a vital historical foodstuff for indigenous Californian tribes, who ground them into dense flour. (橡實是加州原住民部落至關重要的歷史食品糧食原料，他們將其磨成濃密的粉末。)

meaning: 山腳下的小丘；丘陵地帶
example: Ancestral pueblo builders chose to situate their multi-story stone villages near a fertile canyon foothill zone. (祖傳普埃布洛建造者選擇將他們的多層石造村落，安置在一個肥沃的峽谷山腳下丘陵地帶附近。)
Fossilized footprints yield clues regarding the walking posture, speed, and weight of extinct organisms. (化石足跡為滅絕生物的行走姿勢、速度和重量提供了線索。)
An individual ant functions as an active forager, secreting specialized trail pheromones once a food resource is pinpointed. (單隻螞蟻充當活躍的覓食者，一旦精確指出食物資源，就會分泌特化的足跡費洛蒙。)

The mercantile caravan had to locate a shallow gravel river zone to safely ford their heavily laden horse carts. (商業商隊不得不尋找一個淺淺的礫石河流區域，以便讓他們重載的馬車安全涉水而過。)
The constitutional scholars analyzed the original political philosophies articulated by the nation's founding forefathers. (憲法學者分析了由國家開國先祖前輩們所闡述的原始政治哲學。)
The comparative anatomy study detailed the evolutionary adaptation of the whale's forelimb into a flipper. (這項比較解剖學研究詳細描述了鯨魚前肢演化為鰭狀肢的適應性過程。)

meaning: 縮短透視；用透視法縮短

The government forester monitored old-growth timberline reserves to assess how climatic variations altered broadleaf seed outputs. (政府林務員監測古老原始的林木線保護區，以評估氣候變異如何改變闊葉樹種子的產出。)
The five indigenous tribes met annually to formalize the legal and organizational guidelines of their confederacy. (五個原住民部落每年會面，以使其聯盟的法律與組織方針正式化。)
The ancestral pueblo people erected monumental wall fortification infrastructure to deter aggressive invaders. (祖傳普埃布洛人建造了宏偉的牆壁防禦工事基礎設施，以嚇阻具侵略性的入侵者。)
The fragile transitional theropod fossil was fortuitously unearthed when road builders split an unaltered shale bedrock layer. (當道路建設者劈開一層未改變的頁岩基岩時，這具脆弱的過渡期獸腳類恐龍化石幸運地（偶然地）被挖掘了出來。)
Fossilization requires rapid burial beneath sediment to prevent decomposition and scavenging by predators. (化石作用需要迅速埋藏在沉積物之下，以防止分解和被捕食者食腐。)
Under rare geochemical conditions, even the delicate soft tissues of an animal can occasionally fossilize. (在罕見的地球化學條件下，甚至連動物精細的軟組織有時也能變成化石。)
The founding of the Iroquois Confederacy formalized legal and organizational agreements across five separate indigenous tribes. (易洛魁聯盟的創立，使五個獨立原住民部落之間的法律與組織協議正式化。)
The fragile shipping container was clearly marked to warn personnel about the extreme fragility of the glass lenses. (這個脆弱的運輸貨櫃有清晰的標記，以警告人員關於玻璃鏡片極端的易碎性。)
Historians had to reconstruct the ancient legal code based on fragmentary records preserved in different libraries. (歷史學家必須根據保存在不同圖書館中的殘缺記錄，來重建古代法典。)

meaning: 富蘭克林 (歷史人物例：班傑明·富蘭克林)
example: Benjamin Franklin conducted early electromagnetic experiments, adding lawlike regularities to our primitive grasp of physics. (班傑明·富蘭克林進行了早期的電磁實驗，為我們對物理學的原始掌握增添了有規律性的特徵。)
Because gaseous helium molecules are exceptionally lightweight, they escape freely into the upper layers of the atmosphere. (由於氣態氦分子異常輕巧，牠們會自由地逸出到大氣層的上層。)

meaning: 大一新生（英式英美語常用）、更清新的

Lichens grow vigorously on freshly cooled basaltic lava rock formations following a volcanic eruption. (在火山爆發後，地衣在新鮮冷卻的玄武岩岩漿岩構造上蓬勃生長。)
Lakes and rivers contain only a tiny fraction of Earth's total water, serving as essential freshwater habitats. (湖泊和河流僅占地球總水量的一小部分，卻是至關重要的淡水棲地。)

meaning: 佛洛伊德的；佛洛伊德學派的
example: The Freudian school of psychology emphasizes the psychodynamic influence of suppressed childhood trauma on adult amnesia. (佛洛伊德心理學派強調被壓抑的童年創傷，對成年失憶症所產生的心理動力學影響。)
The historical documentarian highlighted the apparent friendliness between pioneer homesteaders and ancestral pueblo dwellers. (歷史紀錄片工作者強調了拓荒農莊主與祖傳普埃布洛居民之間明顯的友好關係。)
The woolly mammoth possessed exceptional anatomical adaptations designed to endure the frigid climate of the Ice Age. (長毛象具備卓越的解剖適應能力，旨在忍受冰河時期的嚴寒氣候。)
The veterinary clinic noted that the puppy became remarkably frisky after recovering from the infection. (獸醫診所注意到，小狗在從感染中康復後，變得異常活潑歡鬧。)
The serious academic environment left very little room for frivolity or unprofessional conduct. (嚴肅的學術環境幾乎沒有給輕浮或不專業的行為留下一點空間。)

meaning: 輕浮的；不重要的；瑣碎的
example: The court dismissed the frivolous lawsuit because it lacked any verifiable legal basis or logical arguments. (法院駁回了這起無聊的瑣碎訴訟，因為它缺乏任何可證實的法律依據或邏輯論點。)
Ancient Egyptian wall art emphasized strict frontality, ensuring the chest and eyes always maintained a frontal orientation. (古埃及牆壁藝術強調嚴格的正面性，確保胸部與眼睛始終保持正面的朝向。)

meaning: 正面性 (藝術中的正面描繪)
example: Ancient Egyptian wall reliefs frequently exhibited strict frontality, depicting eyes and shoulders facing forward. (古埃及牆壁浮雕經常表現出嚴格的正面性，將眼睛和肩膀描繪為面向正前方。)
Her frugal lifestyle allowed her to save enough money to buy a house. (她節儉的生活方式使她存夠了買房子的錢。)
The interdisciplinary symposium was praised for its fruitfulness, yielding several collaborative research grants. (這場跨學科座談會因其富有成效而受到讚譽，產生了數個合作研究資助專案。)
After three weeks of fruitless searching, the maritime rescue team suspended operations in the northern sector. (在經歷了三週徒勞無功的搜尋後，海上救援隊暫停了北區的行動。)

meaning: 富勒 (如富勒土、縮絨工)；更完整的

The pest control professionals had to completely fumigate the apartment building to eradicate the termite infestation. (除蟲專業人員必須對整棟公寓大樓進行全面煙燻消毒，以根除白蟻帶來的危害。)
Architectural functionalism dictating early factory design demanded that all layouts reject ornate decoration for utility. (主導早期工廠設計的建築功能主義，要求所有規劃都必須拒絕華麗的裝飾以追求實用性。)
A fungal infestation can swiftly decompose the structural timberline logs used to reinforce the fortress walls. (真菌的侵染會迅速分解用來加固堡壘牆壁的結構性林木線原木。)
Fungi play a vital role in ecosystems by decomposing dead organic matter. (真菌透過分解死亡的有機物在生態系統中發揮至關重要的作用。)
Orchard agriculturalists utilize synthetic copper-sulfate fungicide solutions to combat destructive fungal spores inside cedar trees. (果園農業勞動者利用合成的硫酸銅殺真菌劑溶液，來對抗雪松樹內部的破壞性真菌孢子。)
A fungus breaks down organic matter, playing a critical role as a decomposer within the forest ecosystem. (真菌能分解有機物，在森林生態系統中扮演分解者的關鍵角色。)
The narrow mountain gorge acts to funnel regional winds into a high-velocity, dynamic alpine airstream. (狹窄的山谷峽谷起到將區域風匯集成高速、動態的高山氣流的作用。)

meaning: 家具、室內陳設（常用複數）
example: The luxury apartment's contemporary furnishings were carefully selected to complement the architectural layout. (這間豪華公寓的當代室內陳設經過精心挑選，以與建築格局相得益彰。)
The Arctic fox has a thick, furry coat that provides exceptional thermal insulation against freezing sub-zero temperatures. (北極狐擁有厚實、毛茸茸的皮毛，能針對零下低溫提供卓越的保暖效果。)
The rescue team realized that further search efforts were futile given the catastrophic extent of the avalanche. (鑑於雪崩造成的災難性程度，救援隊意識到進一步的搜尋努力已是徒勞無功。)
Biomechanical engineers analyzed the specific gait of the primate to design advanced bipedal walking robots. (生物力學工程師分析了靈長類動物的特定步態，以設計先進的雙足步行機器人。)
Gallium is a low-melting metal that is highly vital for modern semiconductor manufacturing. (鎵是一種低熔點金屬，對現代半導體製造至關重要。)
A gamma ray burst represents an incredibly energetic cosmic explosion that releases massive radiation. (伽馬射線暴代表了一種能量極其巨大的宇宙爆炸，會釋放出大量的輻射。)
The actors dressed in traditional medieval garb to accurately represent the historical period of the play. (演員們穿著傳統的中世紀服裝，以準確呈現該劇的歷史時期。)
The shift from nomadic foraging to intensive home gardening marked the dawn of early Neolithic settlements. (從游牧採集向密集家庭園藝活動的轉變，標誌著新石器時代早期定居點的曙光。)
The Roman empire maintained a permanent military garrison along the frontier to deter foreign incursions. (羅馬帝國在邊境沿線維持著一支永久的軍隊駐軍，以嚇阻外敵入侵。)
The Beringia land bridge emerged as a critical geographic gateway, permitting early hominid migration into America. (白令陸橋顯現為一個關鍵的地理通道（大門），容許早期原始人類遷移進入美洲。)
A Paleolithic gatherer possessed extensive botanical knowledge, pinpointing which wild tubers were nutritionally dense. (舊石器時代的採集者擁有廣泛的植物學知識，能精確指出哪些野生塊莖在營養上是密集的。)
The geological research facility specialized in analyzing the crystal structures of rare gemstone varieties. (該地質研究設施專門分析稀有寶石品種的晶體結構。)
Crows are classified as ecological generalist feeders, adapting their diet fluidly to exploit diverse human foodstuffs. (烏鴉被歸類為生態全能型（通才）覓食生物，能流暢地調整飲食以利用多樣的人類食品。)

An aphid population can be genetically identical due to repeated cycles of asexual reproduction. (由於無性生殖的反覆循環，蚜蟲群體在基因上可能是完全相同的。)

Her innate gentility and polite manners made a lasting, positive impression on everyone she met. (她天生的文雅氣質與禮貌舉止，給她遇到的每個人都留下了深刻且良好的印象。)
Despite the fierce corporate rivalry, the competing executives maintained a gentlemanly demeanor during negotiations. (儘管公司競爭激烈，競爭的高階主管在談判期間仍保持著有紳士風度的舉止。)
By implementing cross-referenced tree ring timelines, geochronologists can genuinely validate radiocarbon dates. (藉由實施交叉比對的年輪時間線，地球年代學家可以真正地驗證放射性碳日期。)
A historical geographer traces how early railway networks transformed peripheral rural landscapes into commercial farmlands. (一位歷史地理學家追蹤早期的鐵路網絡如何將周邊的農村景觀轉化為商業農田。)

The cruel gibe from his opponent failed to disrupt the politician's focus during the live televised debate. (在電視直播辯論中，對手殘酷的嘲諷並未能干擾這位政治人物的專注力。)
The Strait of Gibraltar forms a narrow seaway connecting the Atlantic Ocean with the Mediterranean Basin. (直布羅陀海峽形成了一條狹窄的海上航道，連接大西洋與地中海盆地。)
The restorative historical architects carefully applied a thin layer of gold gilding to the palace gates. (修復古蹟的歷史建築師小心翼翼地在皇宮大門上塗了一層薄薄的鍍金。)

The set designer chose a traditional blue-and-white gingham cloth for the farmhouse kitchen scene. (佈景設計師為農舍廚房場景選擇了傳統的藍白格紋布。)
Glacial valleys are characteristically U-shaped, carved out by the immense weight and movement of moving ice sheets. (冰河谷的特徵通常呈U型，是由移動冰原的巨大重量與移動所雕琢出來的。)

An expert glassmaker precisely regulated kiln temperatures to melt silicate ores without structural cracking. (一位專家級的玻璃製造工匠精確調節窯溫，以融化矽酸鹽礦石而不發生結構性龜裂。)
The expansion of advanced glassmaking craft inside Roman antiquity metropolis centers required airtight stone kiln infrastructures. (羅馬古代大都市中心內部先進玻璃製造工藝的擴張，需要密閉的石窯基礎設施。)
Rapid solidification of silica-rich lava under seawater generates a glassy volcanic obsidian configuration. (富含矽的岩漿在海水中快速凝固，會製造出玻璃質的火山黑曜石構造。)
A glassy ceramic glaze not only waterproofs earthenware pottery but also provides decorative coloration. (玻璃質的陶瓷釉料不僅能使土器陶器防水，還能提供裝飾性的色彩。)

meaning: 搜集（情報、知識等）、點滴收集

The midwest metropolis cathedral featured a grandiose Gothic facade, showcasing strict architectural symmetry and masonry towers. (中西部大都市的大教堂以宏偉的哥德式正面為特色，展現出嚴格的建築對稱性與石造高塔。)

meaning: 不透明水彩畫、不透明水彩顏料

Ancestral pueblo agrarian groups cultivated the hollow gourd plant, utilizing its dried hard shell as a lightweight watercraft flask. (祖傳普埃布洛農業群體耕作中空的葫蘆植物，利用其乾燥的硬殼作為輕巧的水上水壺容器。)
